advancedExpressions.example: I am convinced that no one is more suitable for this honour than Li Hua, whose kindness has touched us all. （最高级 + 定语从句提供理由,推荐信主体）

advancedExpressions.expression: what is suitable for one ... is not necessarily suitable for ...
advancedExpressions.example: What is suitable for one learner is not necessarily suitable for another; hence education must never be one-size-fits-all. （对比排比 + hence 推理,论证个性化）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She looked for suitable clothes for the party.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Standing before the open wardrobe, she agonised over what to wear, casting aside dress after dress until, at last, she found the one outfit suitable for a night she would never forget. （读后续写·心理+动作）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词状语开头 + agonise over 情绪动词 + cast aside dress after dress 反复动作 + 定语从句渲染场合的分量

sentenceUpgrade.original: This place is suitable for our activity.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Having weighed every option, we concluded that the riverside pavilion was by far the most suitable venue for our reading festival, both spacious and steeped in tranquillity. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 完成式分词状语(Having weighed) + by far 加强最高级 + 形容词短语补充(both...and...)增加信息密度

classPractice.question: This film contains some violent scenes and is not ____ (suit) for young children.
classPractice.note: be suitable for 适合;句中缺形容词,由动词 suit 变形容词 suitable

classPractice.question: The scientists spent months looking for music that was ____ (suitable / unsuitable) for representing all of humankind.
classPractice.note: 语境需"合适的"音乐来代表人类,用 suitable;反义 unsuitable=不合适的

classPractice.question: 在我看来，李华是这个职位最合适的人选。In my opinion, Li Hua is the ____ ____ candidate ____ this position.
classPractice.note: the most suitable 最高级 + be suitable for 搭配,介词 for 不可换

translation: 录音，视频；录制；记录
original_sentence: China is represented by a recording of Guan Pinghu (7) _________________ (play) an ancient piece called Flowing Water on the Chinese instrument qin.
readingExamples: China is represented by a recording of Guan Pinghu (7) _________________ (play) an ancient piece called Flowing Water on the Chinese instrument qin.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a piece of sound, music, or video that has been captured and stored on a device or medium
(2) n. the act or process of registering sound or images so they can be reproduced later
(3) n. a written or documented account in which facts, figures, or events are set down

posExamples.sentence: Years after her grandmother had passed away, she stumbled upon an old recording of the lullaby, and the trembling voice filled the room as if time itself had folded back. （读后续写·睹物思人）
I am writing to invite you to submit a short recording of your favourite poem for our school's 'Voices of Spring' audio exhibition. （应用文·邀请信）
In an age when a single recording can circle the globe within seconds, we must reflect seriously on the boundary between sharing and privacy. （议论文·科技与隐私）
The coach played the recording of yesterday's match again and again, freezing each frame so the players could see exactly where their teamwork had faltered. （读后续写·体育反思）

wordForms.noun: recording (n. 录音，录像) / record (n. 记录;唱片;最高纪录) / recorder (n. 录音机;记录员;竖笛)
wordForms.adjective: recorded (adj. 录制的) / recording (adj. 录音的，记录用的)
wordForms.other: 词族一串:record(动/名) → recording(录音成果) → recorder(录音设备/人)。重音辨析:record 作名词重音在前 /ˈrekɔːd/(记录、唱片),作动词重音在后 /rɪˈkɔːd/(录制)。区分 record(泛指记录、唱片、纪录) 与 recording(专指录下来的声音/影像)

collocations.example: China is represented by a recording of Guan Pinghu playing an ancient piece. 中国由一段管平湖演奏古曲的录音来代表。（课文原句）
The choir gathered after school to make a recording that would be broadcast on the city radio. （应用文·活动通知）
The teacher played a recording of native speakers so that we could imitate their natural rhythm. （应用文·学习方法）
The album was a live recording, and you could hear the audience holding its breath before the final note. （读后续写·音乐现场）
A short video recording of the ceremony was sent to every graduate as a keepsake. （应用文·纪念）
When the young pianist finally released his first recording, critics hailed it as a revelation. （读后续写·艺术成就）
Stepping into the recording studio for the first time, the nervous singer suddenly forgot every word she had rehearsed. （读后续写·紧张时刻）
The scientists kept a detailed recording of every tremor the mountain produced that spring. （议论文·科学研究）

synonyms.example: The event set a new world record, and photographers scrambled to capture the historic moment. （读后续写·突破时刻）
synonyms.usage: 作名词时,record 更泛指'书面记录'或'最高纪录',也指老式唱片;recording 特指'录制下来的声音或影像'

synonyms.example: The documentary drew on rare footage of the earthquake's aftermath. （议论文·纪实报道）
synonyms.usage: 专指'一段影像素材',尤其是新闻或纪录片中的原始片段;recording 涵盖音频与视频,范围更广

synonyms.example: The final track on the album moved the entire audience to tears. （读后续写·音乐感染力）
synonyms.usage: 指录音作品中的'一首单曲/一条音轨';recording 指整个录制成果,不限于单首

advancedExpressions.expression: make a recording 录制 / break a record 打破纪录 / keep a record of 记录 / set a record 创纪录 / on record 有记录的
advancedExpressions.example: The band made a live recording that broke every sales record on file. （make a recording 与 break a record 同句,凸显 recording/record 之别）

advancedExpressions.expression: record(v.) + -ing → recording(n. 动作的结果/成果);同理 build→building, paint→painting, meet→meeting
advancedExpressions.example: The recording of the concert captured every note; the recording alone took three hours. （前 recording=录制这一动作,后 recording=录下的成品,一词两义）

advancedExpressions.expression: as the recording played, ... came flooding back
advancedExpressions.example: As the old recording played, memories she had long buried came flooding back, vivid and aching. （as 引导背景动作 + come flooding back 触发回忆闪回）

advancedExpressions.expression: you are warmly invited to submit a recording of ...
advancedExpressions.example: You are warmly invited to submit a recording of any traditional folk song, so that our cultures may speak to one another across the miles. （被动邀请句式 + so that 目的状语,征集启事）

advancedExpressions.expression: in an era when a recording can ..., we must ...
advancedExpressions.example: In an era when a single recording can be shared with millions overnight, we must weigh the power of technology against the fragility of privacy. （when 定语从句设背景 + weigh...against 辩证论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She heard the recording and remembered her mother.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The first crackle of the recording had barely sounded when her mother's warm, unmistakable voice rose from the speaker, and the years she had spent grieving seemed, for one fragile moment, to dissolve into nothing. （读后续写·情感闪回）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: had barely...when 时间倒装衔接 + 五感描写(crackle, warm voice) + for one fragile moment 时间状语放缓节奏 + dissolve into nothing 比喻收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Please send a recording of your song.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We would be most grateful if you could kindly send us a recording of the song closest to your heart, allowing your voice to become part of a chorus that unites our whole community. （应用文·征集信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: would be grateful if 委婉请求 + kindly 礼貌副词 + 现在分词状语(allowing...)延伸意义 + 定语从句升华活动意义

classPractice.question: China is represented by a ____ (record) of Guan Pinghu playing the qin, which was sent into deep space.
classPractice.note: a recording of sth=…的录音;此处需名词,record→recording(录制成品)

classPractice.question: The athlete broke the world ____ (record / recording), and a video ____ (record / recording) of the race went viral online.
classPractice.note: record"纪录"(break the record);recording"录像"(a video recording),二者不可混

classPractice.question: 老师给我们播放了一段母语者的录音，好让我们模仿语调。The teacher played us ____ ____ ____ native speakers so that we could imitate the intonation.
classPractice.note: a recording of sb/sth 某人/某物的录音;of 引出录音内容

translation: 遥远的，久远的；久远的，遥远的；冷淡的，疏远的
original_sentence: We do not know what will happen in the end, but maybe the sound of the qin will one day be heard on a distant planet.
readingExamples: We do not know what will happen in the end, but maybe the sound of the qin will one day be heard on a distant planet.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. far away in space; located a long way off
(2) adj. far away in time, whether in the past or the future
(3) adj. not closely related; only remotely connected in family or kinship
(4) adj. emotionally cold, reserved, or unfriendly in manner

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 冷淡的，疏远的，冷漠的（指人的态度）
uncommonMeanings.example: Ever since the quarrel, her father had grown strangely distant, answering her questions with nothing more than a curt nod and a gaze fixed on the far wall. （读后续写·亲情裂痕·情感疏离）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （表情、眼神）出神的，走神的，恍惚的
uncommonMeanings.example: A distant look crept into her eyes, as though her mind had wandered off to a place none of us could follow. （读后续写·人物出神·心理描写）

posExamples.sentence: From the summit, the climbers gazed at the distant city, its lights flickering like scattered stars beneath a blanket of drifting cloud. （读后续写·登山远眺）
I am writing to share a distant but treasured memory of the summer camp we attended together three years ago. （应用文·书信回忆）
The dream of a world free from hunger may still seem distant, yet every act of kindness brings that day imperceptibly closer. （议论文·理想与希望）
A distant rumble of thunder rolled across the valley, and the shepherd quickened his pace, glancing anxiously at the darkening sky. （读后续写·环境预兆）

wordForms.noun: distance (n. 距离，远处，间距)
wordForms.verb: distance (vt. 使疏远;distance oneself from 与…保持距离)
wordForms.other: 词族:distance(n./v.) ↔ distant(adj.) ↔ distantly(adv.)。搭配 in the distance 在远处 / at a distance 隔开一段距离 / keep sb at a distance 与某人保持距离(不亲近)。distance oneself from 疏远、撇清关系。别把名词 distance 和形容词 distant 拼混(注意 -ance vs -ant 词尾)

collocations.example: Maybe the sound of the qin will one day be heard on a distant planet. 也许有一天，古琴之声会在某颗遥远的行星上被听到。（课文原句）
In the not-too-distant future, cars may drive themselves. 在不太遥远的将来，汽车也许能自动驾驶。
He inherited the house from a distant relative. 他从一位远亲那里继承了这栋房子。
As a boy he had dreamed of sailing to a distant land where the mountains touched the clouds. （读后续写·童年梦想）
What seems science fiction today may, in the not-too-distant future, become a part of everyday life. （议论文·科技展望）
The hardships of that winter are now no more than a distant memory, softened by the passage of time. （读后续写·回望往事）
Somewhere in the distant hills a bell tolled, its lonely note carried on the evening wind. （读后续写·环境渲染）
A distant cry for help broke the silence, and without a second thought she plunged into the icy river. （读后续写·紧急救援）
As the years wore on, the two old friends slowly grew distant, until their letters ceased altogether. （读后续写·友情变迁）
She wore a distant look, her thoughts clearly a thousand miles from the crowded classroom. （读后续写·人物走神）

synonyms.example: The rescue team trekked for two days to reach the remote village cut off by the landslide. （读后续写·救援）
synonyms.usage: 更强调'偏僻、与世隔绝、难以到达',常修饰地点;也指可能性'渺茫'。distant 中性地表示'距离远',不必然含'难达'之意

synonyms.example: With a faraway smile, the old sailor began to speak of oceans he had crossed long ago. （读后续写·怀旧）
synonyms.usage: 偏文学、抒情色彩,既指地理遥远,也生动地指'出神的表情';distant 更书面、更通用

synonyms.example: The new manager kept himself aloof, rarely joining the staff for lunch or casual conversation. （议论文·人际态度）
synonyms.usage: 专指人'态度上刻意保持距离、冷淡超然',贬义较明显;distant 指人冷淡时较委婉,且还可表'距离/时间遥远'

advancedExpressions.expression: in the distance 在远处 / at a distance 隔一段距离 / the not-too-distant future 不太遥远的将来 / keep sb at a distance 疏远 / distance oneself from 与…划清界限
advancedExpressions.example: Standing at a distance, she watched the house shrink into a distant speck and vowed to distance herself from that painful past. （名词短语 + 形容词 + 动词三形态同句）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·一词多义(距离/时间/关系/态度)
advancedExpressions.expression: distant 四义:① 空间遥远 a distant planet ② 时间久远 the distant past ③ 关系疏远 a distant relative ④ 态度冷淡 a distant manner
advancedExpressions.example: Since the quarrel he had grown distant, his cold, distant replies making that once-close friendship feel as distant as a childhood memory. （"态度冷淡"与"时间遥远"两义同句,展示多义）

advancedExpressions.expression: in the distant ..., sth stirred / loomed
advancedExpressions.example: In the distant treeline, something stirred — a shadow too large to be a deer, too silent to be the wind. （in the distant 设远景 + 破折号引出悬念,制造紧张）

advancedExpressions.expression: though the memory is distant, it remains ...
advancedExpressions.example: Though the memory is now distant, it remains as vivid in my heart as the day it was made. （though 让步 + 对比 distant/vivid,书信抒情）

advancedExpressions.expression: the goal may seem distant, yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: The goal of universal literacy may seem distant, yet history teaches us that no dream is beyond reach once determination takes hold. （may seem distant 承认困难 + yet 转折立论）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They saw a city far away.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far below, the distant city sprawled across the plain, its countless windows catching the last of the sun so that the whole valley seemed to shimmer like a sea of gold. （读后续写·远景描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 方位状语开头(Far below) + sprawl 生动动词 + 现在分词状语(catching...)+ so that 结果从句 + shimmer/sea of gold 明喻升华画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: One day peace will come, but it is far off now.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Peace, however distant it may appear at this dark hour, is a dawn that no night, however long, can forever hold back. （议论文·希望论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 插入让步从句(however distant it may appear) + dawn/night 隐喻 + however long 二次让步叠加 + hold back 拟人化增强感染力

classPractice.question: Ever since the quarrel, her father had grown strangely ____ (distance), answering her with nothing but a cold nod.
classPractice.note: 此处作表语需形容词 distant(态度冷淡);distance 是名词/动词,别混拼

classPractice.question: We could hear a bell ringing somewhere ____ (in the distance / distant), its lonely note drifting on the wind.
classPractice.note: in the distance=在远处(固定短语,distance 名词);distant 是形容词不能单独作状语

classPractice.question: 自动驾驶汽车在不太遥远的将来也许会普及。Self-driving cars may become common in the ____-____-____ ____.
classPractice.note: the not-too-distant future=不太遥远的将来,固定表达,distant 修饰 future

translation: 音量，响度；体积，容积；卷，册
original_sentence: I turned up the volume and stood staring at the radio, holding my breath and waiting for the first notes of the song.
readingExamples: I turned up the volume and stood staring at the radio, holding my breath and waiting for the first notes of the song.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the degree of loudness of a sound, or the control that adjusts it
(2) n. the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, measured in cubic units
(3) n. one book in a series, or a single bound collection of writings
(4) n. the total quantity or amount of something, especially when large

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】音量，响度（可调节的声音大小；turn up / down the volume）
uncommonMeanings.example: I turned up the volume and stood staring at the radio. 我调高音量，站着盯着收音机。（课件·课文原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（书的）卷，册，一大部书（a volume of poetry）
uncommonMeanings.example: She pulled a slim volume of poetry from the shelf. 她从书架上抽出一本薄薄的诗集。（课件·熟词多义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】总量，数量之多（the volume of traffic 交通流量）
uncommonMeanings.example: the volume of traffic 交通流量（课件·熟词多义 总量）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 体积，容积（占据的空间，可计算）
uncommonMeanings.example: To find the volume of the box, multiply its length, width and height. 求盒子的体积，要把长、宽、高相乘。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 大量，大批（尤指数量之多）
uncommonMeanings.example: The sheer volume of applications overwhelmed the small committee, who had never expected such a flood of eager hopefuls. （应用文·活动反响·数量之大）

posExamples.sentence: She turned up the volume until the drums thundered through the tiny bedroom, and for one glorious moment every worry in her fifteen-year-old world melted away. （读后续写·青春宣泄）
May I kindly remind residents to keep the volume of their music at a reasonable level after ten o'clock, out of consideration for our neighbours. （应用文·通知/倡议）
The rising volume of plastic waste dumped into our oceans each year is a silent alarm that humanity can no longer afford to ignore. （议论文·环保）
To measure the irregular stone's volume, the young scientist lowered it gently into the beaker and watched the water climb the marked line. （读后续写·科学实验）

wordForms.noun: volume

idioms.translation: 很说明问题，意味深长（无声却极有说服力）
idioms.example: She said nothing at all, but the tears glistening in her eyes spoke volumes about the pain she had borne in silence. （读后续写·无声胜有声）

collocations.phrase: turn up / turn down the volume
collocations.translation: 【课件】调高／调低音量（课文原句语境）
collocations.example: I turned up the volume and stood staring at the radio, holding my breath. 我调高音量，站着盯着收音机，屏住呼吸。（课件·课文原句）

collocations.phrase: a volume of poetry / a volume of poems
collocations.translation: 【课件】一卷／一册诗集（volume=书的"卷、册"）
collocations.example: She pulled a slim volume of poetry from the dusty shelf. 她从落满灰尘的书架上抽出一本薄薄的诗集。（课件·熟词多义 卷/册）

collocations.translation: 【课件】交通流量（volume=总量、数量之多）
collocations.example: The volume of traffic on the old bridge had grown far too heavy. 那座旧桥上的车流量已经变得过大。（课件·熟词多义 总量）
The stadium speakers blared the anthem at full volume, and thirty thousand voices rose to join it. （读后续写·赛场氛围）

collocations.phrase: the volume of sth (体积/容积)
collocations.example: The students were asked to calculate the volume of the cylinder using the formula they had just learnt. （议论文·数学教学）
A huge volume of donations poured in within hours, proving how deeply the community cared. （应用文·慈善报道）

collocations.translation: 在体积/数量上增加或减少
collocations.example: As it cools, the metal contracts and decreases slightly in volume. （议论文·科学说明）
She had devoured the first volume in a single night and could scarcely wait for the next. （读后续写·痴迷阅读）
The sheer volume of work left the interns exhausted, yet strangely fulfilled. （应用文·实习感悟）
The students were asked to calculate the volume of the cylinder using the formula they had just learnt. （议论文·数学教学）

synonyms.example: The reservoir has a capacity of two million litres, enough to see the town through the driest summer. （议论文·资源）
synonyms.usage: 指容器'能容纳的最大量',强调上限;volume 指实际'占据的空间'或已装的量,不必然是上限

synonyms.example: The quality of your reading matters far more than the quantity of books you rush through. （议论文·读书方法）
synonyms.usage: 泛指可数或不可数的'数量',中性;volume 作'数量'讲时强调'规模庞大、成批的量'

synonyms.example: The loudness of the fireworks startled the sleeping child awake. （读后续写·突发声响）
synonyms.usage: 专指声音的'大小、响度'这一物理属性;volume 更常用于设备可调节的'音量'语境

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·熟词多义(音量/体积/卷/数量)
advancedExpressions.expression: volume 四义合记:① 音量 turn up the volume ② 体积/容积 the volume of a box ③ (书的)卷、册 Volume One ④ (庞大的)数量 a huge volume of
advancedExpressions.example: He turned up the volume, opened Volume Two, measured the jar's volume, and marvelled at the sheer volume of notes inside. （一句四义,系统记熟词僻义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表"大量"
advancedExpressions.expression: a large volume of / a great deal of / a vast amount of / an enormous quantity of + 不可数名词
advancedExpressions.example: The city produces a huge volume of waste each day, a vast amount of which could easily be recycled. （volume of 与 amount of 并置,升级"大量"表达）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·speak volumes 高分句
advancedExpressions.expression: sb's silence / expression / actions speak volumes about ... 无声却极具说服力
advancedExpressions.example: How a person treats a stranger speaks volumes about his true character. （"speak volumes about"议论文金句,含 volume 的固定习语）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. turned up the volume until ...
advancedExpressions.example: She turned up the volume until the music drowned out the world, and only then did the tears finally come. （until 引导结果 + only then 倒装,释放压抑情绪）

advancedExpressions.expression: may I kindly remind you to keep the volume ...
advancedExpressions.example: May I kindly remind everyone to keep the volume down during study hours, so that all of us may concentrate in peace. （may I kindly remind 委婉句式 + so that 目的,倡议规劝）

advancedExpressions.expression: the sheer volume of ... is a wake-up call / cannot be ignored
advancedExpressions.example: The sheer volume of information we consume daily is a wake-up call: without the ability to think critically, we risk drowning in noise. （sheer volume 强调规模 + 冒号引出论断）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He made the music louder because he was happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Overcome with a joy too great to contain, he cranked the volume to its limit and let the pounding rhythm carry him, dancing wildly, around the sunlit room. （读后续写·喜悦爆发）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词状语开头(Overcome with...) + too...to 结构 + crank 生动动词 + 现在分词伴随状语(dancing wildly) + sunlit 环境点染

sentenceUpgrade.original: There is too much rubbish in the sea.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The staggering volume of rubbish choking our seas is not merely an environmental issue but a moral indictment of the throwaway culture we have so carelessly embraced. （议论文·环保立论）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: staggering volume 强化数量冲击 + choking 拟人化动词 + not merely...but 递进结构 + moral indictment 抽象升华拔高立意

classPractice.question: (a) He ____ ____ the volume so the whole street could hear the music. (b) To find the ____ of the tank, multiply length by width by height.
classPractice.note: 考 volume 两义:turn up the volume 调高音量 / the volume 体积;同词不同义

classPractice.question: 她一言不发，但眼中的泪水已充分说明了一切。She said nothing, but the tears in her eyes ____ ____ about her grief.
classPractice.note: speak volumes (about sth)=意味深长、很说明问题;volumes 恒用复数

classPractice.question: 每天涌入的大量申请让这个小委员会应接不暇。（用 a huge volume of）
classPractice.answer: The huge volume of applications pouring in each day overwhelmed the small committee.
classPractice.note: a huge volume of + 名词=大量的,volume 表"数量之多"

translation: vi. 盯着看，凝视，注视 | n. 盯，凝视，注视
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to look at someone or something for a long time with the eyes wide open, often in surprise, shock, or deep thought
(2) vi. to gaze fixedly and steadily, sometimes rudely or blankly
(3) n. a long, fixed look, often expressing curiosity, hostility, or amazement

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （危险、事实等）明摆在眼前，逼近（常用 stare sb in the face）
uncommonMeanings.example: With the deadline staring him in the face and not a single word written, he felt panic tighten its cold grip around his chest. （读后续写·压力逼近·危机临头）

posExamples.sentence: The little boy stood frozen at the doorway, staring at the towering Christmas tree as though he had wandered straight into a dream he dared not wake from. （读后续写·童真惊喜）
I noticed a stranger staring intently at the lost wallet on the bench, and without hesitation I stepped forward to hand it in to the guard. （应用文·记叙类书信）
Under the teacher's unwavering stare, the whispering gradually died away until the whole classroom fell into an uneasy silence. （读后续写·课堂威严）
It is unwise, some argue, to stare passively at the challenges of a changing climate, hoping they will somehow resolve themselves. （议论文·环境行动）

wordForms.noun: stare

idioms.translation: （危险、事实等）明摆着，迫在眉睫
idioms.example: Defeat was staring them in the face, yet the captain refused to surrender a single inch of the pitch. （读后续写·绝境不屈）

idioms.translation: 两眼发直地望着，出神发呆
idioms.example: He sat motionless by the window, staring into space, his mind lost somewhere far beyond the grey horizon. （读后续写·出神发呆）

collocations.translation: 【课件】凝视，盯着看（to look at sb/sth for a long time；核心介词 at）
collocations.example: What are you staring at? 你在盯着什么看？（课件·Integrated skills）

collocations.translation: 【课件】盯着前方（发呆）／凝视远方
collocations.example: She sat there staring into space / the distance. 她坐在那里盯着前方。（课件·Integrated skills）

collocations.phrase: stare up / down at sb / sth
collocations.example: The child stared up at the towering statue in silent wonder. 孩子抬头注视着高耸的雕像，默默惊叹。（课件·Integrated skills 搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】面无表情地注视着某人（名词用法）
collocations.example: When I asked for directions, he only gave me a blank stare. 我问路时，他只是面无表情地盯着我。（课件·Integrated skills）
He stared out of the window, watching the rain streak down the glass. 他向窗外凝视，看着雨水在玻璃上流下。（课件·Integrated skills）

collocations.phrase: give sb a long hard stare
collocations.translation: 【课件】狠狠地盯某人好一会（名词 stare）
collocations.example: She gave him a long hard stare. 她狠狠地盯了他好一会。（课件·Integrated skills）

collocations.translation: 【课件】站着盯着某物看（课文原句结构）
collocations.example: I turned up the volume and stood staring at the radio. 我调高音量，站着盯着收音机。（课件·课文原句）

collocations.translation: 茫然/空洞的凝视（名词用法）
collocations.example: He met my question with a blank stare. 面对我的问题，他只是茫然地盯着。

collocations.translation: 惊讶地/难以置信地/恐惧地盯着看
collocations.example: The villagers stared in horror as the flames leapt from rooftop to rooftop, devouring everything in their path. （读后续写·灾难场景）
Asked what had happened, the shaken child only stared blankly, unable to summon a single word. （读后续写·创伤反应）
For a long while she stared into space, wrestling with a decision that would change everything. （读后续写·内心挣扎）
He stood staring at the departing train, his hand still half-raised in a goodbye that came too late. （读后续写·离别遗憾）

collocations.translation: 茫然的/冷漠的/空洞的凝视
collocations.example: The interviewer met his boast with a cold stare that instantly stripped away his false confidence. （读后续写·人物交锋）
She refused to look away, meeting his hostile stare with a calm that unsettled him. （读后续写·勇气对峙）
The cat fixed its unblinking stare on the fluttering moth, every muscle coiled to spring. （读后续写·环境细节）

synonyms.translation: 凝视，注视（常含深情或欣赏）
synonyms.example: Hand in hand, they gazed at the setting sun, letting its golden warmth wash over their tired faces. （读后续写·温情画面）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:gaze 多含正面、专注、深情或欣赏的意味,较柔和(gaze at the stars/one's lover);stare 更中性甚至带无礼、震惊或敌意,眼睛睁得更大更久。三词一图:gaze(深情凝望)—stare(睁大眼久盯)—glare(愤怒地瞪),都接 at,程度/情绪各异

synonyms.example: She glared at the boy who had shoved her sister, her fists trembling with fury. （读后续写·愤怒对峙）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:glare 特指"愤怒地瞪视",情绪强烈且负面(glare at sb angrily);stare 情绪更广(惊讶、好奇、发呆皆可),不一定含怒意

synonyms.example: He glanced nervously at the clock and realised there was no time left to lose. （读后续写·紧张时刻）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:glance 指"短暂快速地一瞥",与 stare 的"长久固定注视"恰好相反,是其反义参照;glance at 一眼扫过 vs stare at 死死盯住

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·stare 一组搭配(课件)
advancedExpressions.expression: stare at 盯着 / stare into space / the distance 盯着前方·凝视远方 / stare up·down at 抬头·低头注视 / stare out of 向外凝视 / give sb a blank stare 面无表情注视 / give sb a long hard stare 狠狠盯好一会
advancedExpressions.example: He stood staring into space, then stared up at me and gave me a long hard stare. （课件搭配串联，动词 vi. 与名词 n. 一并覆盖）

advancedExpressions.expression: stare at 盯着 / stare into space 出神发呆 / stare sb in the face (危险)迫在眉睫 / stand staring 呆立凝望 / a blank stare 茫然的目光
advancedExpressions.example: He stood staring into space, deaf to the world, while the deadline stared him in the face. （stare 三种用法同句，凝练高效）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:"看"的层次
advancedExpressions.expression: glance(一瞥) → glimpse(瞥见) → look at(看) → watch(观看) → gaze(凝望) → stare(盯) → glare(怒瞪) 由轻到重
advancedExpressions.example: She glanced at him, then looked again, and finally stared in open disbelief. （glance→look→stare 递进,写出情绪升级）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. stood frozen, staring at ..., as though ...
advancedExpressions.example: She stood frozen, staring at the empty crib, as though sheer disbelief alone could undo what had happened. （stood frozen 定格动作 + as though 引导虚拟,放大震惊）

advancedExpressions.expression: I could not help staring at ..., which ...
advancedExpressions.example: I could not help staring at the elderly cleaner, who, unnoticed by the hurrying crowd, quietly returned a dropped purse to its owner. （could not help doing + 非限定从句,记叙感人见闻）

advancedExpressions.expression: we cannot afford to merely stare at ... and hope ...
advancedExpressions.example: We cannot afford to merely stare at the widening gap between rich and poor and hope it will close on its own. （cannot afford to 警示句式 + and hope 讽刺消极态度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She looked at the radio and waited for the song.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She stood rooted to the spot, staring at the glowing radio dial, holding her breath as she waited for the first trembling notes to break the silence. （读后续写·期待时刻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: rooted to the spot 定格动作 + 现在分词状语连用(staring..., holding...) + trembling notes 通感修饰 + break the silence 动静对比营造张力

sentenceUpgrade.original: People should not ignore this problem.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To stare idly at a crisis of such magnitude, trusting that it will simply fade away, is not patience but a dangerous form of denial. （议论文·批判消极）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 不定式短语作主语(To stare idly at...) + 现在分词状语(trusting...)+ not...but 对比 + a dangerous form of denial 抽象定性,升华批判力度

classPractice.question: I turned up the volume and stood ____ (stare) at the radio, waiting for the first notes of the song.
classPractice.note: 【课件·课文原句】stand doing 站着做某事；stare 与 stood 是伴随动作，用现在分词 staring

classPractice.question: Furious at the insult, she ____ (stared / glared / gazed) at him, her eyes blazing with anger.
classPractice.note: 带强烈怒意用 glare；stare 中性(睁大久看)，gaze 含深情，都不合"blazing with anger"语境

classPractice.question: 他坐在窗边出神发呆，思绪早已飘向远方。He sat by the window, ____ ____ ____, his mind far away.
classPractice.note: stare into space=出神发呆、两眼发直；现在分词作伴随状语

translation: 呼吸的空气；一次吸入的空气；气息，迹象
original_sentence: Sweet and low, sweet and low, Wind of the western sea, Low, low, breathe and blow, Wind of the western sea!
readingExamples: Sweet and low, sweet and low, Wind of the western sea, Low, low, breathe and blow, Wind of the western sea!
definitionEn:
(1) n. the air that you take into your lungs and send out again
(2) n. a single act of breathing air in and out
(3) n. a slight sign, hint or trace of something
(4) n. a very small movement of air

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一丝，一点点（迹象、气息）
uncommonMeanings.example: There was not a breath of scandal attached to his name; even his rivals conceded that his integrity was beyond reproach. （议论文·人物评价·清白无瑕）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 微风，一丝气流
uncommonMeanings.example: Not a breath of wind stirred the willow leaves, and the whole valley lay hushed, as if holding itself still to listen. （读后续写·环境烘托·静谧）

posExamples.sentence: As she crossed the finish line, she doubled over, hands on her knees, her breath coming in ragged gasps, yet a triumphant smile spread across her flushed face. （读后续写·比赛冲刺·力竭与喜悦）
I am writing to remind every participant that, before delivering your speech, you should take a slow, deep breath to steady your nerves and let your words carry conviction. （应用文·演讲指导信）
A moment spent in nature — feeling the crisp mountain air fill one's breath — can do more to restore a weary mind than any amount of medication. （议论文·亲近自然·身心疗愈）
The instant the results were announced, the entire hall held its breath, and in that suspended silence you could almost hear a hundred hearts pounding at once. （读后续写·揭晓时刻·屏息）

wordForms.noun: breath (n. 呼吸，气息)
wordForms.other: ★重点辨析拼写发音：breath 是名词/breθ/(读“布莱斯”，无 e 尾音)；breathe 是动词/briːð/(读“布莱兹”，末尾 e，元音更长、词尾浊音)。名 breath 动 breathe，多一个 e 就变动词。派生 breathing (n./adj. 呼吸的)

idioms.example: The whole village held its breath as the rescue team lowered the rope, inch by agonising inch, into the flooded shaft. （读后续写·救援现场·紧张）

idioms.translation: 喘口气，歇口气；倒吸一口凉气
idioms.example: Only after sprinting up all six flights did she pause to catch her breath, clutching the railing and laughing at her own recklessness. （读后续写·奔跑之后·喘息）

idioms.translation: 使人惊叹，美得令人窒息
idioms.example: As the mist lifted, the sight of the golden sunrise flooding the terraced fields simply took our breath away. （读后续写·登顶观景·惊叹）

idioms.translation: 令人耳目一新的人或事
idioms.example: Her honest, down-to-earth speech was a breath of fresh air after so many rehearsed, hollow promises. （应用文·活动感言·清新）
He burst through the door, out of breath and wide-eyed, waving the letter that would change everything. （读后续写·突发消息·气喘）

idioms.translation: 紧接着（说出前后矛盾的话）
idioms.example: She praised his talent and, in the same breath, warned him against the arrogance that had ruined so many before him. （读后续写·长辈忠告·转折）

collocations.translation: 【课件】屏住呼吸；（比喻）焦急等待
collocations.example: I turned up the volume and stood staring at the radio, holding my breath and waiting for the first notes of the song. 我调高音量，站着盯着收音机，屏住呼吸，等待歌曲的第一个音符。（课件·课文原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】深吸一口气（常为镇定、鼓劲）
collocations.example: She took a deep breath, steadied her voice, and began her speech. 她深吸一口气，稳住嗓音，开始了演讲。（课件·breath 高频搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】上气不接下气，气喘吁吁
collocations.example: He raced up the stairs and burst in, out of breath but grinning from ear to ear. 他冲上楼撞门而入，上气不接下气却笑得合不拢嘴。（课件·breath 高频搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】喘口气，歇口气；倒吸一口凉气
collocations.example: Only after sprinting up all six flights did she pause to catch her breath. 一口气冲上六层楼后，她才停下来喘口气。（课件·breath 高频搭配）

collocations.translation: 一股新鲜空气；（比喻）令人耳目一新的人或事
collocations.example: Her frank, cheerful manner was a breath of fresh air in the tense office. （读后续写/议论文·新人·清新）
He could scarcely draw a breath as the examiner slowly turned over the final page of his portfolio. （读后续写·等待评判·紧张）
Dragged ashore at last, the boy lay on the sand gasping for breath, while his mother sobbed with relief beside him. （读后续写·溺水获救·脱险）
Halfway up the ridge my grandfather grew short of breath, so we sat on a warm rock and let the wind cool our faces. （读后续写·登山陪伴·体贴）
With bated breath the audience watched the tightrope walker inch across the gorge, arms trembling against the wind. （读后续写·杂技表演·惊险）
I soon realised I was wasting my breath, for his mind was as firmly shut as a bolted door. （读后续写·劝说无果·无奈）
"You'll regret this," she muttered under her breath, her fists clenched at her sides. （读后续写·压抑愤怒·低语）
There was barely a breath of wind that sweltering afternoon, and the flags hung limp against their poles. （读后续写·酷暑·环境描写）

synonyms.example: Take a deep breath (n.) and breathe (v.) slowly. 深吸一口气，慢慢呼吸。（课件·辨析：名词 breath /breθ/ 无 e 尾音；动词 breathe /briːð/ 末尾多一个 e，词尾浊音；形容词 breathless）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：breath 是名词/breθ/（呼吸、气息，如 hold one's breath, take a deep breath）；breathe 是动词/briːð/（做"呼吸"这个动作），多一个 e 即变动词。形容词 breathless（气喘的），可作状语 They waited, breathless.

synonyms.example: A gasp of astonishment rippled through the crowd as the curtain fell away to reveal the winning design. （读后续写·揭晓·惊讶）
synonyms.usage: 指急促、突然的一次吸气，常伴随惊讶或费力；breath 是中性的"呼吸/气息"，gasp 情绪更强烈、更有画面感

synonyms.example: The doctor monitored the patient's respiration closely through the long, uncertain night. （应用文·病情说明）
synonyms.usage: 为正式/科技用语，指整体呼吸生理过程；日常叙事、口语和续写中一律用 breath

synonyms.example: With one triumphant puff she blew out all the candles, and the room erupted into cheers. （读后续写·生日·欢乐）
synonyms.usage: 指短促、一小口的气，动作感强、偏轻松场景；不能替代"气息/生命迹象"义

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·形容词作状语(课件 breathless)
advancedExpressions.expression: ..., breathless, ... （形容词作状语，说明动作执行者的状态）
advancedExpressions.example: They waited, breathless, for the result. 他们屏住呼吸等待结果。（课件·Reading 形容词作状语；breathless 是形容词，注意名词用 breath、动词用 breathe）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·breath 高频搭配(课件)
advancedExpressions.expression: hold one's breath 屏息 / take a deep breath 深吸一口气 / out of breath 上气不接下气 / catch one's breath 喘口气
advancedExpressions.example: Out of breath after the sprint, he paused to catch his breath, took a deep breath, and — as the results flashed up — held his breath along with everyone else. （课件四大高频短语一句串联；突出 breath 是名词，动作用 breathe）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·breath / breathe 名动之别(课件辨析)
advancedExpressions.expression: breath (n.) → breathe (v.) → breathless / breathtaking (adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: Take a deep breath (n.) and breathe (v.) slowly; the view was so breathtaking that it left us breathless. （名词 breath、动词 breathe、形容词 breathtaking/breathless 一族齐现，区分词性与拼写）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·分词短语作状语
advancedExpressions.expression: ..., breathing hard / out of breath, sb. did sth.
advancedExpressions.example: Out of breath and trembling, she still forced a smile and pushed the door open. （形容词短语 out of breath 作状语前置，续写中浓缩"气喘+动作"）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. hold one's breath, waiting for ...
advancedExpressions.example: The entire team held its breath, every eye fixed on the scoreboard, waiting for the number that would decide a year of sweat and sacrifice. （"hold one's breath + 定语从句"制造悬念，续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us take a moment to draw a breath and reflect on ...
advancedExpressions.example: Before we rush headlong into the new term, let us take a moment to draw a breath and reflect on how far our small acts of kindness have carried us. （倡议信引出反思，用呼吸意象放缓节奏）

advancedExpressions.expression: sth. breathes new life into ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from replacing tradition, thoughtful innovation breathes new life into it, giving age-old customs renewed meaning for a younger generation. （"breathe new life into"隐喻论证，化抽象为具象；注意此处用动词 breathe）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She was tired and breathed hard.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She staggered the last few steps and collapsed against the wall, her chest heaving and her breath coming in short, burning gasps, yet through it all her eyes shone with the fierce joy of one who had refused to give up. （读后续写·力竭·身心描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动作细节(staggered, collapsed) + 身体描写(chest heaving, breath in gasps) + yet转折凸显精神 + "one who..."定语从句升华人物

sentenceUpgrade.original: The view was beautiful.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The panorama that unfolded before us was so breathtakingly vast that, for a long moment, no one spoke — we simply stood there, letting the sight steal the very breath from our lungs. （读后续写·观景·惊叹）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: breathtakingly副词强化 + so...that结果状语 + 破折号补充留白 + "steal the breath"拟人化收束情感

classPractice.question: Take a deep ____ (breathe) and calm down before you go on stage.
classPractice.note: 空格前有 a deep，需名词 breath；动词才是 breathe，拼写差一个 e

classPractice.question: 用 breath / breathe 填空：(1) It is hard to ____ at such high altitudes. (2) She ran so fast that she was out of ____.
classPractice.note: 情态/实义动词位置用 breathe；固定短语 out of breath 用名词 breath

classPractice.question: 她的坦率就像一股清新的空气。Her frankness was ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ in the dull meeting.
classPractice.note: a breath of fresh air 令人耳目一新的人/事，比喻用法

translation: 特别的，不寻常的；独特的，与众不同的
original_sentence: However, this was not unusual.
readingExamples: However, this was not unusual.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. different from what is common, normal or expected; not usual
(2) adj. interesting and attractive because of being different from what is ordinary
(3) adj. remarkable or striking in a way that stands out from others

posExamples.sentence: It was an unusual sight: a grown man kneeling in the pouring rain to shelter a stray kitten beneath his coat, oblivious to the crowd hurrying past. （读后续写·街头善举·反常一幕）
I am writing to recommend Lucy for the exchange programme, for she possesses an unusual combination of curiosity, discipline and warmth that sets her apart from her peers. （应用文·推荐信）
It is by no means unusual for great discoveries to spring from apparent failures; indeed, some of history's finest breakthroughs were born of experiments that went spectacularly wrong. （议论文·失败与创新）
There was something unusual about the old man's eyes — a quiet, knowing gleam that made me feel he had seen far more of the world than his shabby coat suggested. （读后续写·人物刻画·神秘）

wordForms.adjective: unusual (不寻常的) ↔ usual (通常的，反义)
wordForms.other: 反义前缀 un-：usual→unusual；同族 usually / as usual (照常) / more than usual (比往常更)

collocations.phrase: it is unusual for sb. to do sth.
collocations.translation: 某人做某事是不寻常的
collocations.example: It was unusual for my reserved grandfather to laugh out loud, so the whole family turned to look. （读后续写·家庭·反常温情）
However, this was not unusual. （课文原句·选择性必修一 U2；此处 not unusual 即“并不稀奇”）
The nurse noticed nothing unusual during her round, yet an uneasy feeling lingered as she switched off the ward lights. （读后续写·夜班·不祥预感）
It was highly unusual for the headmaster to summon a student in person, and my mind raced through every rule I might have broken. （读后续写·被叫办公室·忐忑）
The judges were struck by the boy's unusual talent for turning ordinary scraps of metal into delicate, lifelike sculptures. （读后续写·才艺展示·惊艳）
The classroom was unusually quiet that morning, for word of the surprise inspection had spread like wildfire. （读后续写·气氛·反常）
She expressed her gratitude in an unusual way — not with words, but with a handwritten letter tucked quietly into each classmate's desk. （读后续写·感恩·独特方式）
Such acts of quiet generosity are far from unusual in this small mountain community, where neighbours have always looked after one another. （议论文/记叙·乡邻互助）
The dish owed its charm to an unusual combination of sweetness and spice that lingered pleasantly on the tongue. （应用文·美食推介）

synonyms.example: What she achieved that afternoon was nothing short of extraordinary — a feat that would be talked about for years. （读后续写·壮举·赞叹）
synonyms.usage: 语气更强，强调"远超常人、令人惊叹"，多含褒义；unusual 只是"与平常不同"，中性、程度较轻

synonyms.translation: 值得注意的，引人瞩目的
synonyms.example: The village's remarkable transformation, from a forgotten hamlet to a thriving tourist town, drew visitors from across the province. （议论文·乡村振兴）
synonyms.usage: 强调"值得注意、令人称道"，侧重引起关注；unusual 侧重"不常见"，未必带评价色彩

synonyms.example: There was a peculiar smell in the corridor, faint but unmistakable, that made her quicken her pace. （读后续写·悬疑·怪异）
synonyms.usage: 常带"古怪、令人不安"的负面或神秘意味；也可表"特有的"。unusual 更中性，peculiar 情感色彩更浓

synonyms.example: It is not uncommon for shy students to blossom once they find a stage that truly suits them. （议论文·因材施教）
synonyms.usage: 偏书面、客观，多用于"数量上少见"；与 unusual 常可互换，但 unusual 更能形容"奇特有趣"的个性

advancedExpressions.expression: it is unusual for sb. to do / nothing unusual / there is something unusual about / far from unusual
advancedExpressions.example: There was something unusual about the house, though nothing unusual met the eye; it was, in fact, far from unusual for the old place to feel watchful at dusk. （一句串联四个高频结构，覆盖 for sb. to do 与 about sth.）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·“不寻常/非凡”
advancedExpressions.expression: unusual → extraordinary / remarkable / peculiar / uncommon
advancedExpressions.example: What began as an unusual choice soon proved extraordinary, a remarkable and by no means uncommon path that only seemed peculiar to those who never tried it. （由中性 unusual 升到褒义 extraordinary/remarkable，按语气强弱排列换用）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·it 作形式主语
advancedExpressions.expression: It is unusual for sb. to do sth.
advancedExpressions.example: It is unusual for him to arrive late. （It 作形式主语，真正主语是 for sb. to do；for 后的名词/代词是不定式的逻辑主语，与形容词 kind/nice 后用 of 区别）

advancedExpressions.expression: there was something unusual about ...
advancedExpressions.example: There was something unusual about the silence that greeted us at the door — too complete, too deliberate, as though the house itself were hiding a secret. （"there was something unusual about"埋伏笔，破折号补充制造悬疑）

advancedExpressions.expression: possess an unusual combination of ...
advancedExpressions.example: She possesses an unusual combination of talent and humility that makes her not only an outstanding performer but also a beloved teammate. （推荐信中并列褒扬，用"unusual combination"凸显独特性）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is by no means unusual for ... to ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is by no means unusual for adversity to reveal strengths that comfort could never have uncovered; hardship, in this sense, is often our sternest yet finest teacher. （"it is by no means unusual for"引出普遍规律，隐喻收束论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The boy had an unusual hobby.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The boy had an unusual passion that set him apart from every other child in the village: while his friends chased footballs across the dusty square, he would sit for hours by the pond, sketching the ripples until dusk crept in. （读后续写·人物·独特爱好）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: passion替换hobby升级 + "that set him apart"定语从句 + while对比句式 + 环境细节(dusk crept in)营造画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: It is not unusual for students to feel nervous.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is by no means unusual for even the most diligent students to be gripped by nerves before a crucial exam; what truly distinguishes the successful, however, is their ability to transform that anxiety into sharpened focus. （议论文·心态·化压力为动力）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: by no means加强否定 + "be gripped by"拟人化 + what...however分裂句强调对比 + transform...into升华论点

classPractice.question: It is not ____ (usual) for such a shy boy to volunteer, so everyone was surprised.
classPractice.note: 反义前缀 un-；It is unusual for sb. to do 是某人做某事不寻常

classPractice.question: 他迟到实属反常。____ ____ ____ ____ him to be late.
classPractice.note: It is unusual for sb. to do sth.；for 后接不定式的逻辑主语

classPractice.question: 选词填空(unusual / usually)：The train was ____ crowded this morning, ____ it is almost empty.
classPractice.note: 第一空修饰形容词 crowded 用副词 unusually；第二空表“通常”用 usually，区分正反义与副词

translation: 吸引；抓住，抓取；攫取，抢夺
original_sentence: They immediately grabbed the attention of young people and soon the youth of the country were being swept along on waves of joyous rock and roll music and the hope for a better future.
readingExamples: They immediately grabbed the attention of young people and soon the youth of the country were being swept along on waves of joyous rock and roll music and the hope for a better future.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to take hold of something or someone suddenly and roughly
(2) v. to take or get something quickly, especially because you do not have much time
(3) v. to get someone's attention or interest quickly and strongly
(4) v. to take an opportunity eagerly when it arises
(5) n. a sudden attempt to take hold of something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 抢夺；突然的抓取动作
uncommonMeanings.example: He made a desperate grab for the falling vase, but his fingers closed on nothing but air. （读后续写·失手瞬间·懊恼）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （up for grabs）唾手可得的，谁都能争取的
uncommonMeanings.example: With the champion retiring, the title was suddenly up for grabs, and every young contender in the country dared to dream. （读后续写·机会·群雄逐鹿）

posExamples.sentence: Without a second's hesitation, she grabbed the child by the collar and hauled him back from the roaring traffic, her heart hammering against her ribs. （读后续写·危急施救·本能反应）
The opening line of a good composition should grab the reader's attention at once, plunging them straight into the heart of the scene rather than easing in with vague generalities. （应用文/议论文·写作指导）
When opportunity finally knocks, the wise do not hesitate; they grab it with both hands, knowing that such moments rarely come twice in a lifetime. （议论文·把握机遇）
He grabbed at the rope as the current dragged him under, his knuckles white, his mind fixed on a single thought: hold on. （读后续写·落水挣扎·求生）

wordForms.noun: grab (n. 突然的抓取/抢夺)
wordForms.other: ★双写规则：grab 以“重读闭音节+单辅音 b”结尾，加 -ed/-ing 须双写 b → grabbed / grabbing；同类 stop→stopped, plan→planned

idioms.translation: （奖项、机会等）人人可争的，唾手可得的
idioms.example: Three scholarships were up for grabs, and for the first time the shy girl from the back row dared to raise her hand. （读后续写·机会·勇敢争取）
We barely had time to grab a bite before the afternoon rehearsal swept us back onto the stage. （读后续写·忙碌·争分夺秒）

idioms.idiom: grab the bull by the horns
idioms.translation: 迎难而上，果断处理棘手问题
idioms.example: Instead of waiting for the problem to sort itself out, she grabbed the bull by the horns and confronted the issue head-on. （议论文·担当·果敢行动）

idioms.translation: 你觉得这主意怎么样？（口语）
idioms.example: "A surprise picnic for Grandma's birthday — how does that grab you?" she asked, eyes sparkling with mischief. （读后续写·提议·俏皮对话）

collocations.example: They immediately grabbed the attention of young people. （课文原句·选择性必修一 U2；grab one's attention 迅速抓住注意力）
We only had ten minutes to grab a bite before the next rehearsal began. （读后续写·忙碌·争分夺秒）
She grabbed the chance to study abroad with both hands, refusing to let hardship deter her. （读后续写·抉择·果敢）
As the boat lurched, he grabbed hold of the mast and shouted for the others to do the same. （读后续写·风浪·惊险）

collocations.phrase: grab sb. by the arm / collar
collocations.example: A stranger grabbed me by the arm and pulled me back just as the cyclist swerved past — I owe that split second to a face I never saw again. （读后续写·陌生人相救·感恩）
The drowning man grabbed at the branch again and again, each miss more frantic than the last. （读后续写·挣扎·绝望）
The young inventor's solar-powered lamp grabbed the headlines and, more importantly, brought light to hundreds of remote homes. （议论文·青年担当·社会影响）
Rather than grab the limelight for himself, the captain stepped aside and let his quieter teammates take a well-earned bow. （读后续写·谦让·团队精神）

synonyms.example: Seizing the moment, she stepped forward and volunteered before doubt could talk her out of it. （读后续写·果断·把握时机）
synonyms.usage: 更正式、更有力，强调"迅速而坚决地攫取"，尤其搭配 seize the opportunity/moment；grab 偏口语、动作更粗暴随意

synonyms.example: The gust of wind snatched the letter from her hand and sent it dancing across the courtyard. （读后续写·风·意外）
synonyms.usage: 强调"猛地夺走、抢走"，常含突然性与被夺者的不情愿；grab 侧重"抓住"，snatch 侧重"抢走、夺离"

synonyms.example: He grasped the railing tightly, refusing to let the trembling in his legs betray his fear. （读后续写·恐高·强撑）
synonyms.usage: 指"稳稳地、有意识地握牢"，动作比 grab 从容；还可表"理解、领会"（grab 无此义）

synonyms.example: The lost child clutched her teddy bear to her chest, her eyes darting fearfully through the crowd. （读后续写·走失·惊惶）
synonyms.usage: 强调"因害怕或急切而紧紧攥住不放"，情绪色彩浓；grab 是"抓取"的瞬间动作，clutch 是"死死攥住"的持续状态

advancedExpressions.expression: grab one's attention / grab the chance / grab a bite / up for grabs / grab hold of
advancedExpressions.example: With the top prize up for grabs, she grabbed the chance, grabbed her rivals' attention with a bold opening, and barely had time to grab a bite all day. （一句串联四个高频短语，覆盖“吸引/抓机会/匆匆吃/人人可得”）

advancedExpressions.expression: grab → seize / snatch / grasp / clutch
advancedExpressions.example: He grabbed the rail, seized the moment, snatched the falling child and clutched her tight — four verbs, four shades of “catching”. （grab 口语粗放，seize 坚决抢占，snatch 猛地夺走，clutch 因怕而死攥，按语气与场景换用）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·双写辅音再加尾缀
advancedExpressions.expression: grab → grabbed / grabbing
advancedExpressions.example: He grabbed my sleeve, grabbing it so tightly that his knuckles turned white. （重读闭音节单辅音结尾双写 b，过去式与现在分词的拼写考点）

advancedExpressions.expression: without a second's hesitation, sb. grabbed ...
advancedExpressions.example: Without a second's hesitation, he grabbed the fire extinguisher and charged towards the flames, heedless of the danger to himself. （"without a second's hesitation"状语前置+连续动作，凸显本能与勇气）

advancedExpressions.expression: designed to grab the attention of ...
advancedExpressions.example: The campaign, designed to grab the attention of every commuter, features eye-catching visuals and a message no one can easily forget. （过去分词短语作定语，说明宣传目的，措辞正式生动）

advancedExpressions.expression: those who grab opportunities ... , while those who hesitate ...
advancedExpressions.example: Those who grab opportunities with courage often shape their own destinies, while those who hesitate watch such chances slip quietly through their fingers. （对比句式+隐喻(slip through fingers)论证，主旨鲜明）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He grabbed the rope and pulled himself up.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Summoning the last of his strength, he grabbed the rope with both hands and hauled himself upward, inch by trembling inch, until at last he rolled onto the ledge and lay gasping beneath the open sky. （读后续写·攀爬脱险·力竭坚持）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Summoning...分词状语开头 + with both hands强化动作 + inch by trembling inch节奏描写 + until...结果 + 环境收束(open sky)

sentenceUpgrade.original: You should grab good opportunities.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than waiting passively for fortune to smile upon us, we ought to grab every worthwhile opportunity the moment it appears, for hesitation is the surest way to let a lifetime of possibility slip away. （议论文·把握机遇·劝诫）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than...对比引入 + the moment引导时间状语 + for引出原因 + 隐喻(fortune smile, slip away)增强说服力

classPractice.question: The moment the alarm rang, he ____ (grab) his bag and rushed out.
classPractice.note: the moment 引导过去时间状语，用一般过去时；注意双写 b：grabbed

classPractice.question: 生动的开头能立刻抓住读者的注意力。A vivid opening can instantly ____ ____ ____ ____ the reader.
classPractice.note: grab the attention of sb. 抓住某人注意力；课文核心搭配

classPractice.question: With the champion retiring, the title was suddenly ____ ____ ____, and every young player dared to dream.
classPractice.note: up for grabs 人人可得、有待争取，作表语

translation: (swept, swept) 席卷，掠过；扫；扫除，清扫；n. 挥动，扫动
definitionEn:
(1) v. to move quickly and powerfully through or over a place, often affecting a large area
(2) v. to clean a surface using a brush or broom
(3) v. to push, carry or move something along with force
(4) v. to move in a smooth, confident and often grand manner
(5) n. a long, smooth, curving movement or line

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （潮流、情绪、风暴等）横扫、席卷；将某人卷入（sweep + 地点 / sweep sb. along）
uncommonMeanings.example: A wave of panic swept through the crowd as the lights suddenly went out. （读后续写·突发·恐慌蔓延）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 气势十足地大步走，翩然而行（sweep into / out of / past）
uncommonMeanings.example: The headmistress swept into the hall, her long coat billowing, and the murmuring students fell instantly silent. （读后续写·人物登场·威严）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （视野、范围的）延展；一大片；一道弧线/挥动（a sweep of ...）
uncommonMeanings.example: From the summit, a magnificent sweep of golden farmland stretched to the very edge of the horizon. （读后续写·登高远眺·壮阔）

posExamples.sentence: A wave of relief swept over her as the last name on the pass list turned out to be her own, and tears she had held back for weeks finally spilled free. （读后续写·放榜·如释重负）
As volunteers, we should not only plant trees but also sweep the litter from our riverbanks, so that future generations may inherit a cleaner, greener homeland. （应用文·环保倡议书）
A powerful storm swept across the coast overnight, tearing roofs from houses and reminding us all of nature's untamed might. （议论文·自然力量·敬畏）
With one graceful sweep of his brush, the old master brought the crane to life, its wings seeming to stir on the silk. （读后续写·书画技艺·传神）

wordForms.noun: sweep (n. 挥动/一片) / sweeper (清扫者/清扫机)
wordForms.other: ★不规则动词三态：sweep - swept - swept（元音 ee→e，与 keep-kept、sleep-slept 同型）；现在分词 sweeping

idioms.translation: 使某人倾心，令某人神魂颠倒
idioms.example: His quiet kindness, rather than any grand gesture, was what finally swept her off her feet. （读后续写·情感·打动人心）

idioms.idiom: sweep sth. under the carpet / rug
idioms.translation: 掩盖问题，把麻烦藏起来
idioms.example: Instead of sweeping the mistake under the carpet, the honest young manager owned up to it at once. （议论文·诚信·勇于担责）
Our school choir made a clean sweep of the regional competition, carrying home every trophy on offer. （读后续写·比赛·大捷）

idioms.translation: 赢得全部奖项，大获全胜
idioms.example: The debut novelist swept the board at the awards ceremony, silencing everyone who had doubted her. （议论文/记叙·实力·逆袭）

collocations.translation: 横扫，席卷某地（潮流、风暴、情绪）
collocations.example: A craze for the new dance swept through the campus within a week. （读后续写·校园热潮·风靡）

collocations.translation: 裹挟着某人前行；使随大流
collocations.example: The youth of the country were swept along on waves of joyous rock and roll music. （课文原句·选择性必修一 U2；be swept along 被时代浪潮裹挟）
A sudden wave of homesickness swept over the exchange student as the plane rose above the familiar city lights. （读后续写·离别·思乡）
Every morning before class, the two of them quietly swept the floor of the empty classroom, asking neither thanks nor notice. （读后续写·默默奉献·美德）
He swept aside every doubt with a single steady sentence: "We have trained for this — now let us trust ourselves." （读后续写·队长·鼓舞士气）
After the celebration, the volunteers stayed behind to sweep up the confetti long after the last guest had gone. （读后续写·善后·尽责）
The sweeping reforms transformed the sleepy town into a hub of enterprise within a single decade. （议论文·改革·成效）
The hotel balcony offered a sweeping view of the harbour, where sails drifted like scattered petals on the blue. （应用文·景点/旅行推介）

synonyms.example: She brushed the crumbs from the table and set out fresh cups for the unexpected guests. （读后续写·待客·细致）
synonyms.usage: 指用刷子或手轻轻拂扫，动作轻柔、范围小；sweep 力度更大、范围更广，还能表"席卷、气势"

synonyms.example: A surge of pride surged through the crowd as the national flag rose slowly against the morning sky. （读后续写·升旗·自豪）
synonyms.usage: 强调"如波涛般突然而猛烈地涌起"，多用于情绪/人潮；sweep 侧重"横扫、掠过"的移动，surge 侧重"骤然涌起"的力量

synonyms.example: Darkness engulfed the valley the moment the sun dipped behind the ridge. （读后续写·暮色·笼罩）
synonyms.usage: 强调"完全包围、彻底吞没"，程度更重、更具压迫感；sweep 是"扫过、席卷"，engulf 是"整个盖住、淹没"

synonyms.example: With a single confident stroke of the pen, she signed the contract that would change her life. （读后续写·签约·果断）
synonyms.usage: 指笔或手的"一下、一挥"，与 sweep(n.) 的"挥动、弧线"相近，但 stroke 更强调单次、干脆的动作

advancedExpressions.expression: sweep the floor(扫) / sweep through a place(席卷) / a wave swept over sb.(涌来) / sweep sb. off their feet(倾心) / sweep into(翩然而行)
advancedExpressions.example: She swept the floor at dawn, then a wave of nostalgia swept over her — the same song that had once swept the whole town off its feet. （一句展开 sweep 的“扫/涌来/使倾心”三义，凸显一词多义）

advancedExpressions.expression: sweep over → surge / engulf / wash over；brush(轻扫)
advancedExpressions.example: Joy swept over her, pride surged in her chest, and a warmth washed over the whole hall until the moment all but engulfed her. （sweep 掠过、surge 骤涌、wash over 漫过、engulf 吞没，按强度递进换用）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·不规则动词与派生
advancedExpressions.expression: sweep → swept → swept；sweep → sweeping (adj.) / sweeper (n.)
advancedExpressions.example: The sweeping changes that swept the nation were driven by an idea no broom or sweeper could contain. （三态 swept 与派生 sweeping/sweeper 同现，区分动词与形容词）

advancedExpressions.expression: a wave of ... swept over sb.
advancedExpressions.example: A wave of gratitude swept over him as he looked at the faces of the strangers who had stayed all night to search for his lost dog. （"a wave of emotion swept over sb."经典情绪句式，续写抒情段首选）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us join hands to sweep away ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us join hands to sweep away the litter that scars our beautiful campus, and in doing so, sweep away indifference itself. （"sweep away"一语双关，既指清扫垃圾，又象征扫除冷漠，倡议书结尾升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: a tide of ... is sweeping across ...
advancedExpressions.example: A tide of technological innovation is sweeping across every corner of modern life, reshaping not only how we work but who we aspire to become. （"a tide of... sweeping across"宏观论证句式，展现时代趋势）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She felt very happy when she heard the news.

translation: 复杂的，难懂的
original_sentence: I truly love their music and enjoy looking at their musical journey from basic rock and roll, through their experimentation with more complicated and progressive sounds, and then back to the less complicated music of their final records.
readingExamples: I truly love their music and enjoy looking at their musical journey from basic rock and roll, through their experimentation with more complicated and progressive sounds, and then back to the less complicated music of their final records.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. consisting of many different parts or details and therefore difficult to understand
(2) adj. involving a lot of different and confusing aspects; not simple or straightforward
(3) adj. (of a situation or relationship) difficult to deal with because of many conflicting factors
