translation: 天赋，天资；天才
original_sentence: Although he was a genius, Van Gogh was not yet appreciated in the art world.
readingExamples: Although he was a genius, Van Gogh was not yet appreciated in the art world.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an unusually high level of natural mental ability or creative power
(2) n. a person who has exceptional intellectual or creative ability, far beyond the ordinary
(3) n. (a genius for sth) a special natural ability or skill for a particular activity
(4) n. the distinctive character or defining spirit of a place, age, or people

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 特有的天赋、才干(a genius for)
uncommonMeanings.example: She had a genius for turning ordinary afternoons into adventures, so that even a walk to the market became a story worth retelling for years. （读后续写·人物·独特才能）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (某时代/民族/地方的)特有精神、气质
uncommonMeanings.example: The narrow lanes and lantern-lit courtyards captured the very genius of the old town, a spirit no glossy postcard could ever hope to convey. （读后续写·地方风貌）

posExamples.sentence: Bent over his cluttered desk at midnight, the boy scribbled equation after equation, unaware that the strokes of his pencil were the first quiet flickerings of genius. （读后续写·天才初现）
In my opinion, the true genius of our science teacher lies not in what she knows, but in her rare gift for making the whole class fall in love with learning. （应用文·教师颁奖词）
Genius, contrary to popular belief, is seldom a sudden gift from heaven; more often it is the slow harvest of relentless curiosity and thousands of unglamorous hours. （议论文·天才与努力）
Although he was a genius whose paintings would one day command fortunes, he died in poverty, unappreciated by the very world he had striven so hard to move. （读后续写·怀才不遇）

wordForms.noun: genius (天才；天赋); geniuses / genii (pl. 复数); genie (n. 精灵)
wordForms.adjective: ingenious (巧妙的，机灵的); ingenuous (天真坦率的); genial (亲切的，和蔼的)
wordForms.other: 易混拼写·：ingenious(巧妙的，聪明的，指想法/设计) ≠ ingenuous(天真的，坦率的，指人)—仅一字母之差，含义大不同！genial(亲切的) 与 genius 同根但意义不同。复数：geniuses(常用) 或 genii(古体)。genie (n. 精灵，如阿拉丁神灯)

idioms.example: Painting the fence and inviting his friends to 'earn' a turn was a stroke of genius that spared Tom every drop of the labour. （读后续写·机智）
Critics who had once dismissed the symphony now hailed it as a work of genius, though its composer was long past hearing their praise. （议论文·迟来的认可）

collocations.example: Her grandmother had a genius for storytelling. 她奶奶有讲故事的天赋。
Critics now hail the symphony as a work of genius. 评论家如今把这部交响曲誉为天才之作。
Turning the old factory into a library was a stroke of genius. 把旧工厂改成图书馆真是神来之笔。

collocations.translation: 音乐 / 数学 / 艺术天才
collocations.example: The shy exchange student, it turned out, was a mathematical genius who solved in seconds problems that had stumped the whole class. （读后续写·意外发现）
It was in the quiet hours of failure, not the loud moments of triumph, that his true genius revealed itself. （议论文·逆境）

collocations.translation: 创造性的 / 罕见的天才
collocations.example: The world produces a creative genius of her calibre perhaps once in a generation, and even then it often fails to recognise him in his own lifetime. （议论文·天才与时代）
The solution he proposed was sheer genius — so simple that everyone wondered why they had not thought of it themselves. （读后续写·顿悟）
History is littered with unappreciated geniuses whose worth the world discovered only when it was far too late. （议论文·怀才不遇）

collocations.translation: 某事物的精妙之处 / 特有精神
collocations.example: The genius of the ancient bridge lay in its simplicity: no nails, no glue, only the patient logic of interlocking wood. （议论文·传统智慧）

synonyms.example: Her talent for the violin was obvious from the moment her small fingers first found the strings. （读后续写·童年）
synonyms.usage: talent 指某方面的天赋才能,程度可高可低,较常用;genius 程度远高于 talent,指罕见的、非凡的创造力或智力

synonyms.example: The young chess prodigy defeated grandmasters three times her age, her calm eyes betraying no trace of nerves. （读后续写·神童）
synonyms.usage: prodigy 特指年纪很小就展现惊人才能的'神童',强调年龄反差;genius 不限年龄,指天才本身或非凡的天赋

synonyms.example: There was a quiet brilliance in the way she reframed the problem, and the room fell silent in admiration. （议论文·才华）
synonyms.usage: brilliance 指才智的出众、光彩夺目,较抽象;genius 既可指抽象的天赋,也可指'天才'这个人本身

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·天才的多种表达
advancedExpressions.expression: a work of genius / a stroke of genius / a genius for sth / sheer genius
advancedExpressions.example: It was a stroke of genius, a work of genius born of her rare genius for turning limits into leaps. （几种高频固定搭配连用，续写与议论皆可）

advancedExpressions.expression: in that moment, sb. glimpsed the genius that ...
advancedExpressions.example: In that moment, watching him coax music from a battered old piano, she glimpsed the genius that hardship had never managed to silence. （glimpse the genius that... 从细节中窥见天赋,续写深化人物）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·让步 + 强调收束
advancedExpressions.expression: genius may open the door, but it is ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Genius may open the door to greatness, but it is perseverance, not talent alone, that carries one across the threshold. （may...but 让步转折 + it is...that 强调句，议论文点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: in that moment, sb. glimpsed the genius that ...
advancedExpressions.example: In that moment, watching him coax music from a battered old piano, she glimpsed the genius that hardship had never managed to silence. （glimpse the genius that... 从细节中窥见天赋,续写深化人物）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is the quiet genius of ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is the quiet genius of Ms. Lin — her boundless patience and her gift for kindling curiosity — that makes her, in my humble opinion, most deserving of this honour. （颁奖词,以破折号插入具体体现）

advancedExpressions.expression: genius may open the door, but it is ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Genius may open the door to greatness, but it is perseverance, not talent alone, that carries one across the threshold and keeps one there.

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was very talented and became a great artist.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Long before the world would crown him a genius, he was merely a hungry boy sketching in the margins of borrowed books, pouring onto every scrap of paper a vision no hardship could dim. （读后续写·天才起点）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Long before... 时间状语制造反差 + merely a hungry boy 前后境遇对照 + sketching in the margins 细节画面 + pouring...a vision 隐喻式收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: Genius comes from hard work, not just natural ability.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We are too quick to worship genius as a gift of the gods, forgetting that behind almost every dazzling achievement lie years of stubborn, unglamorous toil. （议论文·天才与努力）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: too quick to 批判性开头 + worship...as a gift of the gods 生动比喻 + forgetting that 引出转折 + behind...lie 倒装强调 + stubborn, unglamorous 双形容词点题

classPractice.question: Inviting the audience to name the melody was a ____ of genius that made the whole concert unforgettable.
classPractice.note: a stroke of genius 神来之笔，绝妙主意；固定搭配

classPractice.question: She had a real ____ (genius) for making complicated ideas sound simple.
classPractice.note: a genius for (doing) sth 在某方面的天赋；genius 此处不可数，for 后接名词/动名词

classPractice.question: 辨析选词 (ingenious / ingenuous)：The engineer came up with an ____ design that used half the material yet held twice the weight.
classPractice.note: ingenious 巧妙的、精巧的(指设计/想法)；ingenuous 是'天真坦率的'(指人)，勿混

translation: 变奏，变奏曲；变化，变更；变体，变种
original_sentence: Finally, in the fourth movement, he connects all of the different variations into a joyful chorus.
readingExamples: Finally, in the fourth movement, he connects all of the different variations into a joyful chorus.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a change or slight difference in condition, amount, or level, especially from the usual or expected
(2) n. something that is slightly different from another thing of the same general type; a version
(3) n. (music) a repetition of a simple tune in which the melody or harmony is changed or elaborated
(4) n. a change in the form, structure, or genetic makeup of organisms, resulting in differences between individuals of the same species

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (音乐)变奏,变奏曲
uncommonMeanings.example: The old composer took a humble folk tune and, through a dozen shimmering variations, transformed it into something that made the whole hall weep. （读后续写·音乐·艺术升华）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (生物)变异,变种
uncommonMeanings.example: It is the endless variation among individuals, the biology teacher explained, that gives a species the raw material to adapt and survive. （议论文·生物·进化）

posExamples.sentence: Even the slightest variation in her grandmother's tone told the children whether a bedtime story would end in laughter or in a lesson they would never forget. （读后续写·亲情·细腻观察）
I would like to propose a small variation to our original plan: instead of a single grand event, we could hold a series of smaller gatherings throughout the term. （应用文·建议信）
Wide variation in students' backgrounds should not be treated as an obstacle to fairness, but as a rich resource that enlivens every classroom discussion. （议论文·多元与包容）
As the seasons turned, she recorded each subtle variation in the garden — the first frost, the last rose — as though keeping a diary of time itself. （读后续写·自然·时光流逝）

wordForms.noun: variation (变化，变奏); variety (多样性); variant (变体); variability (可变性)
wordForms.adjective: various (各种各样的); variable (易变的); varied (多样的); invariable (不变的)
wordForms.adverb: variously; variably; invariably (adv. 总是，一贯地)
wordForms.other: 构词法·（vary 词族全家桶）：vary(v. 变化)→ vari- + -ation = variation(n. 变化/变奏)；→ vari- + -ety = variety(n. 多样性，a variety of)；→ vari- + -ous = various(adj.)；→ vari- + -able = variable(adj. 易变的)；vari- + -ant = variant(变体)。辨析：variation(在某基准上的差异/变奏) vs variety(种类的丰富) vs diversity(多元并存)。反义：invariable(不变的) / invariably(总是)

idioms.translation: 同一主题的变体;换汤不换药
idioms.example: Each of his novels was, in truth, a variation on a single theme: the quiet courage of ordinary people facing impossible odds. （议论文·文学评论）

collocations.example: He connects all of the different variations into a joyful chorus. 他把所有不同的变奏连接成欢快的合唱。（课文原句词块）
The survey found wide variation in how much students sleep. 调查发现学生的睡眠时长差异很大。
There is considerable variation in temperature between day and night in the desert. 沙漠里昼夜温差很大。
A subtle variation in her tone told the children a scolding was coming. 她语气里细微的变化让孩子们知道要挨训了。

collocations.translation: 地区差异 / 季节性变化
collocations.example: Regional variation in dialect weaves the country into a tapestry of local voices. 方言的地区差异把这个国家编织成众多地方声音的织锦。
The rich regional variation in dialect, far from dividing the country, weaves it into a tapestry of countless local voices. （议论文·文化多样性）
The seasonal variation in the lake's colour — jade in spring, steel in winter — drew painters from far and wide. （读后续写·自然）

collocations.translation: 温度 / 价格 / 质量的变化
collocations.example: The dramatic variation in temperature between the scorching days and freezing nights tested the endurance of even the hardiest travellers. （读后续写·探险）

collocations.translation: 考虑到差异,留出变化空间
collocations.example: A wise plan must always allow for variation, for reality has a stubborn habit of refusing to unfold exactly as we imagine. （议论文·规划）
Genetic variation within a population is the silent engine of evolution, quietly deciding which traits will endure and which will fade. （议论文·生物）

synonyms.example: The market offered a dazzling variety of fruits, their colours spilling across the stalls like a painter's palette. （读后续写·集市）
synonyms.usage: variety 强调种类的丰富多样(可数/不可数),常作 a variety of;variation 强调在同一事物上的变化、差异或改动,或指音乐变奏

synonyms.example: A sudden change in the weather forced the climbers to abandon their summit attempt. （读后续写·登山）
synonyms.usage: change 是最泛的'变化',可大可小;variation 特指在某基准上的、通常较小或成系列的差异、波动或变体,更书面

synonyms.example: The club prides itself on the diversity of its members, who hail from a dozen different countries. （应用文·社团介绍）
synonyms.usage: diversity 强调种类、来源、背景的多元并存,多用于人群、文化、生态;variation 侧重程度或形式上的差异、变动

advancedExpressions.expression: variation(s) on sth 变奏 / variation in sth 差异 / a variation on a theme 换汤不换药
advancedExpressions.example: The composer spun a dozen variations on the theme, yet the wide variation in mood kept every listener spellbound. （on 表'对……的变奏'，in 表'在……方面的差异'，考点区分）

advancedExpressions.expression: the slightest variation in ... betrayed ...
advancedExpressions.example: The slightest variation in his voice betrayed the storm of emotion he was fighting so hard to hide. （用微小变化 betray 内心波澜,续写刻画克制情感）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·插入让步 + 判断
advancedExpressions.expression: variation, far from being a flaw, is ...
advancedExpressions.example: Variation, far from being a flaw to be ironed out, is the very source of a society's creativity and resilience. （far from being... 插入语作让步，议论文辩证包容）

advancedExpressions.expression: the slightest variation in ... betrayed ...
advancedExpressions.example: The slightest variation in his voice betrayed the storm of emotion he was fighting so hard to hide. （用微小变化 betray 内心波澜,续写刻画克制情感）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would suggest a slight variation to ..., namely ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would suggest a slight variation to the schedule, namely moving the rehearsal to Friday afternoon, so that no one need sacrifice their weekend rest. （建议信,namely 具体化）

advancedExpressions.expression: variation, far from being a flaw, is ...
advancedExpressions.example: Variation, far from being a flaw to be ironed out, is the very source of a society's creativity and resilience.

sentenceUpgrade.original: The music changed the same tune in many ways.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: From a single, unassuming melody the composer spun variation after variation, each one dressing the familiar tune in new colours until the audience scarcely recognised where the journey had begun. （读后续写·音乐·艺术）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: spin...variation after variation 叠词递进 + each one 分说 + dressing...in new colours 隐喻拟人 + until 结果从句 + scarcely recognised 效果烘托

sentenceUpgrade.original: People are different, and that is a good thing for society.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The endless variation among human beings — in thought, in talent, in temperament — is not a problem to be solved but a treasure to be cherished, for it is precisely from our differences that progress is born. （议论文·多元包容）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号插入三项并列 + not...but 对比句式 + a treasure to be cherished 比喻 + for it is precisely...that 强调句收束 + 论证结构完整

classPractice.question: In the fourth movement, he connects all of the different ____ (variation) into a joyful chorus.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；variation 作可数名词，'变奏'常用复数 variations

classPractice.question: 选词填空 (variation / variety / vary)：Prices ____ considerably from one shop to another.
classPractice.note: 此处需谓语动词 vary(变化，不同)；名词 variation/variety 不能作谓语

classPractice.question: The survey revealed wide variation ____ how much time students spent on their phones.
classPractice.note: variation in sth 在某方面的差异；in 后接名词或从句。对比 variation on sth(变奏)

translation: 合唱曲；副歌；合唱团
original_sentence: It has a strong beat and a catchy chorus.
readingExamples: It has a strong beat and a catchy chorus.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a part of a song that is repeated after each verse, usually the most memorable and catchy section
(2) n. a large group of people who sing together, especially in a musical or an opera
(3) n. a piece of music written to be sung by such a group
(4) n. something said or sung by many people at the same time; a burst of sound made simultaneously by many voices

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （众人同时发出的）齐声，异口同声的话语
uncommonMeanings.example: The moment the headmaster announced that classes were cancelled, a deafening chorus of cheers erupted from every corner of the crowded hall. （读后续写·集体欢腾·齐声呼喊）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （古希腊戏剧中的）歌队，合唱队（在剧情间隙评述、旁白）
uncommonMeanings.example: In the ancient tragedy, the chorus stepped forward at each turning point, voicing in solemn unison the fears the audience dared not speak aloud. （议论文·戏剧文化·古典歌队）

posExamples.sentence: As the familiar chorus swelled through the stadium, forty thousand strangers rose to their feet as one, their voices braided into a single wave of sound that sent shivers racing down my spine. （读后续写·演唱会现场·情感共鸣）

I am writing to invite every music lover in our school to join the newly founded chorus, where beginners and experienced singers alike will rehearse together for the spring charity concert. （应用文·招募/邀请信）
A truly great song does not rely on a dazzling chorus alone; rather, it earns its place in our hearts through lyrics that speak honestly to the struggles we all share. （议论文·艺术价值论证）
When the shy new boy finally opened his mouth and led the chorus, the whole classroom fell silent, astonished that so powerful a voice could belong to someone so timid. （读后续写·人物转变·意外之才）

wordForms.noun: chorus (合唱；副歌；齐声); chorister (n. 唱诗班/合唱团成员)
wordForms.verb: chorus (vt. 齐声说，异口同声地说)
wordForms.other: 构词法·：chorus(n.) 可直接作动词'齐声说'（"Yes!" they chorused.）。形容词 choral /ˈkɔːrəl/（合唱的，如 choral music 合唱音乐）。易混：chorus(副歌/合唱团，含义宽) vs choir(唱诗班，尤指教堂) vs refrain(诗歌的叠句) vs verse(主歌)。发音注意 ch- 读 /k/。chorister (n. 唱诗班/合唱团成员)

idioms.example: 'We won't leave without you!' the whole team shouted in chorus, and for the first time in weeks the injured captain felt he truly belonged. （读后续写·团队情谊·齐声承诺）

idioms.idiom: a chorus of approval / protest / complaints
idioms.translation: 一片赞同声／抗议声／怨言
idioms.example: The mayor's careless remark was met with a chorus of protest from residents who had waited years for the promised repairs. （议论文·民意呼声）

collocations.example: It has a strong beat and a catchy chorus. 它有强劲的节拍和朗朗上口的副歌。（课文原句）
"We won't leave without you!" the team shouted in chorus. “我们不会丢下你！”队员们齐声喊道。

collocations.phrase: a chorus of approval / protest / voices
collocations.translation: 一片赞同声 / 抗议声 / 众声
collocations.example: The plan was met with a chorus of protest from parents. 这一计划遭到家长们一片抗议。

collocations.phrase: join in the chorus / sing the chorus
collocations.translation: 加入合唱，一起唱起副歌
collocations.example: By the second verse the whole audience joined in the chorus. 唱到第二段时，全场观众一起唱起了副歌。
By the second verse the entire audience was humming the chorus, swaying gently like a field of wheat in the evening wind. （读后续写·氛围渲染）
She had sung in the school chorus for three years, yet nothing had prepared her for the thunder of a thousand voices at the national finals. （读后续写·成长历练）
A chorus of encouraging voices followed him to the starting line, and suddenly the race no longer felt like a battle he had to fight alone. （读后续写·赛前鼓励）
He rewrote the chorus of the song a dozen times, convinced that the true heart of any melody lived in the lines a listener could not forget. （读后续写·创作执着）
The concert closed with a rousing chorus that lifted every weary spirit in the hall and left not a single pair of hands unclapping. （应用文·演出报道）
The proposal to shorten the summer holiday was drowned out by a chorus of disapproval from students and parents alike. （议论文·舆论反应）

synonyms.example: The old sailor's song had a mournful refrain that returned at the end of every verse like the pull of the tide. （读后续写·怀旧抒情）
synonyms.usage: 更书面、更常用于诗歌,指反复出现的固定诗句或短句;chorus 是流行音乐中'副歌'的通用说法,范围更广,也可指合唱团

synonyms.translation: 唱诗班，（尤指教堂的）合唱团
synonyms.example: Every Sunday the church choir filled the vaulted hall with hymns so pure that even passers-by paused at the door to listen. （读后续写·宗教/庄严场景）
synonyms.usage: 特指有组织的（尤其是教堂或正式场合的）合唱队;chorus 指音乐剧、歌剧或流行演出中的合唱团,也指歌曲副歌,含义更宽

synonyms.example: Each verse told a different chapter of the traveller's lonely journey, but the chorus always brought him home. （读后续写·叙事结构）
synonyms.usage: 指歌曲中歌词不断变化的'主歌'部分,与反复出现的 chorus（副歌）相对,是其结构上的对照概念

advancedExpressions.expression: a catchy chorus 副歌 / in chorus 齐声 / a chorus of + n. 一片……声
advancedExpressions.example: The catchy chorus caught on so fast that, when it played, the crowd sang in chorus and a chorus of cheers rose from every corner. （'副歌'与'齐声/一片声'两义在一句中，帮学生贯通）

advancedExpressions.expression: as the chorus swelled, ... rose / joined as one
advancedExpressions.example: As the chorus swelled to its climax, the whole crowd rose as one, their voices merging into something far greater than any single heart could hold. （as 引导背景 + rise as one 集体动作 + 比喻升华归属感）

advancedExpressions.expression: amid a growing chorus of ..., we must ...
advancedExpressions.example: Amid a growing chorus of concern over screen addiction, we must ask not whether technology is to blame, but whether we have forgotten how to put it down. （amid a chorus of 描摹舆论声势 + not...but 引出深层追问）

advancedExpressions.expression: as the chorus swelled, ... rose / joined as one
advancedExpressions.example: As the chorus swelled to its climax, the whole crowd rose as one, their voices merging into something far greater than any single heart could hold. （as 引导背景 + rise as one 集体动作 + 比喻升华归属感）

advancedExpressions.expression: let our voices unite in one chorus to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let our voices unite in one chorus to remind the world that young people, too, can stand up for the planet we will one day inherit. （let 祈使呼吁 + 隐喻'一个声音'凝聚倡议力量,倡议书收尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: amid a growing chorus of ..., we must ...
advancedExpressions.example: Amid a growing chorus of concern over screen addiction, we must ask not whether technology is to blame, but whether we have forgotten how to put it down. （amid a chorus of 描摹舆论声势 + not...but 引出深层追问）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Everyone sang the chorus together and felt happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the chorus came round again, no one needed prompting: hundreds of voices, young and old, poured into the melody at once, and for one shining moment every difference between us seemed to dissolve into song. （读后续写·集体升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语从句开头(When...) + 冒号引出画面 + 插入语(young and old)扩容 + for one shining moment 定格放缓 + dissolve into song 抽象化收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Many people disagreed with the plan.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The plan was scarcely announced before it was met with a chorus of objections, as parents, teachers and students alike voiced a discontent that could no longer be brushed aside. （议论文·民意论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: scarcely...before 时间倒装 + a chorus of 集合隐喻强化声势 + as 从句列举主体(parents, teachers and students) + could no longer be brushed aside 加重语气

classPractice.question: The song has a strong beat and a catchy ____ (chorus) that everyone can hum after one listen.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文；chorus 作可数名词'副歌'，a catchy chorus 朗朗上口的副歌

classPractice.question: "Happy birthday!" the children shouted ____ ____ as the cake was carried in.
classPractice.note: in chorus 异口同声地、齐声地；固定短语

classPractice.question: 缩短暑假的提议招来一片反对声。The proposal to shorten the summer holiday was met with ____ ____ ____ disapproval.
classPractice.note: a chorus of + 名词 表'一片……声(赞同/反对/抱怨)'，喻指众口一词

translation: 宏大的，宏伟的；壮丽的，堂皇的
original_sentence: We sat outside in my grandparents’ yard while the full moon shone above us.
readingExamples: We sat outside in my grandparents’ yard while the full moon shone above us.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. large and impressive in size, appearance, or style; magnificent
(2) adj. intended to be impressive or ambitious in scope or design
(3) adj. (of a person or their manner) behaving in a way meant to seem superior or dignified
(4) adj. (informal) very good, enjoyable, or pleasant; wonderful
(5) adj. (in fixed terms) most important or final, as in 'grand finale', 'grand total'

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （俚语）一千（英镑或美元），复数不加 s（two grand = 两千）
uncommonMeanings.example: He slid the worn envelope across the table, and inside lay two grand in crumpled notes — every penny the old man had saved for the operation he would never live to have. （读后续写·牺牲奉献·金钱俚义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （言行）自命不凡的，摆架子的，端着的
uncommonMeanings.example: There was something a little too grand in the way she waved off the waiter, as if the small café were quite beneath a person of her standing. （读后续写·人物刻画·傲慢姿态）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （非正式）极好的，令人愉快的（= wonderful）
uncommonMeanings.example: We had a grand time by the sea, and no one wanted the day to end. 我们在海边玩得特别开心，谁都不愿这一天结束。

posExamples.sentence: We sat outside in my grandparents' yard while the full moon shone above us, and the old cherry tree, silvered by the light, suddenly looked as grand as any monument I had ever seen. （读后续写·夜晚温情·环境烘托）
I am writing to share the news that our school will hold a grand opening ceremony for the new library next Friday, and I sincerely hope you can honour us with your presence. （应用文·邀请信）
History reminds us that the grandest dreams are seldom realised in a single stroke; rather, they are built patiently, brick by brick, upon the small acts of countless ordinary people. （议论文·理想与积累）
As the curtains parted, a grand chandelier blazed to life above the stage, and the audience drew in its breath, awed into a hush before a single note had sounded. （读后续写·盛大场面·剧院开场）

wordForms.noun: grandeur (n. 壮丽,宏伟) / grandness
wordForms.adjective: grand (宏伟的); grandiose (夸大的,浮夸的，贬义)
wordForms.other: 构词法/辨析·：grand(adj. 宏大的，褒义/中性)→ grandeur(n. 壮丽) / grandly(adv.)。切勿与 grandiose(几乎总为贬义：'华而不实、好大喜功')混用。固定短语里 grand 表'最重要/最终的'：grand finale(压轴)、grand total(总计)、grand slam(大满贯)。俚语义 = 一千，复数不变(three grand 三千)

idioms.example: He passed away at the grand old age of ninety-eight, still able to recite by heart the poems his mother had taught him as a boy. （读后续写·长寿善终）

idioms.translation: 以盛大／隆重的方式做某事
idioms.example: Determined that their teacher's retirement would not go unmarked, the students bade her farewell in grand style, filling the hall with flowers, music and tears. （读后续写·师生惜别）

collocations.example: The festival ended with a grand finale of fireworks. 节日以盛大的烟花压轴收场。
A dusty grand piano stood in the corner of the empty ballroom. 空荡的舞厅角落里立着一架落满灰尘的三角钢琴。
The city celebrated its anniversary on a grand scale. 这座城市大张旗鼓地庆祝了周年纪念。
The donations came to a grand total of fifty thousand yuan. 捐款总计达五万元。
Behind his quiet manner lay a grand plan to bring clean water to every village. 在他沉静的外表下，藏着一个要为每个村庄引来清水的宏大计划。
She made a grand entrance at the top of the marble staircase, and every conversation in the room died away at the sight of her. （读后续写·人物出场）

collocations.phrase: on a grand scale / in grand style
collocations.example: The company launched its new product on a grand scale, sparing no expense to ensure the world was watching. （应用文·商业活动）
Love, he came to understand, was rarely proved by a single grand gesture, but by a thousand small kindnesses no one else would ever notice. （读后续写·情感领悟）

synonyms.example: From the summit they beheld a magnificent sweep of snow-capped peaks stretching to the very edge of the world. （读后续写·壮阔远景）
synonyms.usage: 语气比 grand 更强,突出'令人惊叹的华美与壮丽',褒义鲜明;grand 侧重'规模宏大、气派堂皇',也可指'雄心勃勃的'或含贬义的'摆架子'

synonyms.example: The hall was decorated in splendid crimson and gold for the New Year banquet. （应用文·节庆场景）
synonyms.usage: 强调'色彩／装饰的绚丽夺目'或口语中'极好的';grand 更强调'体量与气势的宏大',二者都可表'壮观',但侧重不同

synonyms.example: His grandiose promises of overnight riches attracted crowds at first, but not one of them was ever kept. （议论文·批判浮夸）
synonyms.usage: 几乎总是贬义,指计划或言辞'华而不实、大而无当';grand 通常是褒义或中性的'宏大',切勿混用

advancedExpressions.expression: a grand finale 压轴 / a grand scale 大规模 / the grand total 总计 / a grand piano 三角钢琴
advancedExpressions.example: Held on a grand scale, the show built to a grand finale, and the grand total of visitors broke every record. （多个'固定义'搭配一网打尽，考点集中）

advancedExpressions.expression: so grand a ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was so grand a spectacle that even the most restless children stood perfectly still, their upturned faces glowing in the light of the great procession. （so + adj. + a + n. 倒装强调 + that 结果从句渲染场面）

advancedExpressions.expression: grand as ... may sound, it is ... that truly ...
advancedExpressions.example: Grand as sweeping reforms may sound, it is the quiet, unglamorous persistence of ordinary teachers that truly transforms a nation's future. （grand as...may sound 让步倒装 + it is...that 强调句突出真正关键）

advancedExpressions.expression: so grand a ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was so grand a spectacle that even the most restless children stood perfectly still, their upturned faces glowing in the light of the great procession. （so + adj. + a + n. 倒装强调 + that 结果从句渲染场面）

advancedExpressions.expression: we are delighted to host a grand ... and warmly invite you to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We are delighted to host a grand celebration to mark the school's centenary, and we warmly invite you and your family to share in this once-in-a-lifetime occasion. （we are delighted to 正式套语 + warmly invite 礼貌邀约,邀请信主体）

advancedExpressions.expression: grand as ... may sound, it is ... that truly ...
advancedExpressions.example: Grand as sweeping reforms may sound, it is the quiet, unglamorous persistence of ordinary teachers that truly transforms a nation's future. （grand as...may sound 让步倒装 + it is...that 强调句突出真正关键）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The house was very big and beautiful.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Set against the fading violet of the evening sky, the old mansion looked grander than ever, its arched windows glowing like a row of watchful eyes that had witnessed a hundred years of joys and sorrows. （读后续写·建筑描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词状语开头(Set against...) + 比较级(grander than ever) + 现在分词状语(glowing...)+ 明喻(like a row of...eyes) + 拟人化赋予历史厚重感

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should have big dreams but also work hard.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A grand vision may light the way, yet it is only through disciplined, unhurried effort that a distant dream is ever coaxed into reality. （议论文·理想与实干）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 对照结构(may...yet...) + it is only through...that 强调句 + 形容词叠用(disciplined, unhurried) + coax into reality 拟人化收束,增强说理感染力

classPractice.question: 选词填空 (grand / grandiose)：The show built to a ____ finale of fireworks that drew a collective gasp from the crowd.
classPractice.note: grand finale 盛大压轴(褒义/中性)；grandiose 是贬义'浮夸的'，此处不合语境

classPractice.question: When every donation had been counted, the ____ total came to over fifty thousand yuan.
classPractice.note: the grand total 总计、总数；固定搭配，grand 表'最终、总的'

classPractice.question: 辨析选词 (grand / grandiose)：His ____ promises of overnight riches attracted crowds at first, but not one was ever kept.
classPractice.note: grandiose 华而不实、好大喜功(贬义)，与其'空头承诺'的语境相符；grand 通常褒义/中性

translation: 终乐章，末乐章；终场；结局，结尾
original_sentence: 9 was also a grand finale to his life—he died less than three years after the concert in Vienna, aged 56.
readingExamples: 9 was also a grand finale to his life—he died less than three years after the concert in Vienna, aged 56.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the last part of a piece of music, a performance, or a public event, especially an impressive or dramatic one
(2) n. the final movement of a musical work such as a symphony or an opera
(3) n. the concluding scene or episode of a play, film, or series
(4) n. (figuratively) the closing or climactic stage of any process or period

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）（人生、事业、时代等的）终局，收场，落幕
uncommonMeanings.example: The championship was a fitting finale to a career that had known both bitter defeat and glorious triumph, and the old boxer wept openly as the crowd chanted his name one last time. （读后续写·生涯谢幕·比喻终局）

posExamples.sentence: Symphony No. 9 was also a grand finale to his life — he died less than three years after the concert in Vienna, aged 56, yet the music he left behind has outlived him by two whole centuries. （读后续写·作曲家生平·艺术不朽）
I am writing to warmly invite you to the grand finale of our music festival, an evening of orchestral splendour that promises to bring our week-long celebration to an unforgettable close. （应用文·邀请信）
A powerful finale is not merely a loud ending; it is the moment when every earlier note, every quiet hint, converges to reveal a meaning the audience had felt but never quite grasped. （议论文·艺术结构论证）

As the orchestra thundered into its finale, tears streamed silently down the old conductor's cheeks, for he alone knew this would be the last time his trembling hands would ever raise the baton. （读后续写·谢幕时刻·情感高潮）

wordForms.noun: finale / final (n. 决赛) / finalist / finality

idioms.translation: 盛大的压轴，隆重的终场
idioms.example: The gymnast saved her most daring routine for the grand finale, and as she landed flawlessly, the arena erupted in a roar that seemed to shake the very rafters. （读后续写·压轴表演·惊艳收尾）

collocations.translation: 盛大的压轴／隆重的终场（本单元贝多芬《第九交响曲》原句用法）
collocations.example: Symphony No. 9 was a grand finale to Beethoven's life. 《第九交响曲》是贝多芬人生的盛大终章。（课本 a grand finale 用法）

collocations.translation: （活动、演出的）压轴部分，大结局
collocations.example: Fireworks marked the grand finale of the festival. 烟花标志着节日的压轴时刻。
The finale of the symphony was fast and joyful. 这部交响乐的终乐章欢快而急促。

collocations.translation: 为某事画上恰如其分的句号
collocations.example: The gold medal was a fitting finale to her career. 这枚金牌为她的职业生涯画上完美句号。
The night sky exploded into a spectacular finale, and thousands of upturned faces glowed in the shifting colours of the fireworks. （读后续写·烟花终场）
The championship goal, scored in the dying seconds, brought the tournament to a finale so dramatic that even rival fans rose to applaud. （读后续写·比赛高潮）

collocations.phrase: the finale of a symphony / performance
collocations.example: The finale of the symphony began softly, almost hesitantly, before swelling into a triumphant blaze of sound that left the hall breathless. （读后续写·音乐描写）
After hours of fierce competition, the science fair reached a triumphant finale with the announcement of the youngest winner in its history. （应用文·活动报道）
Millions stayed up past midnight to watch the series finale, unwilling to let go of characters who had felt like family for years. （议论文·流行文化）
What had seemed an ordinary debate built, against all expectation, to a dramatic finale that would be quoted for years to come. （议论文·转折论证）

collocations.translation: 以……的终场为某事画上句号
collocations.example: The festival capped its ten-day programme with a finale of a thousand drummers whose rhythm could be felt in the chest. （读后续写·盛大收尾）
The heartfelt speech was a fitting finale to a graduation that none of us would ever forget. （应用文·毕业典礼）

synonyms.example: The rescue reached its climax when the last child was lifted, coughing but alive, from the smoke-filled window. （读后续写·营救高潮）
synonyms.usage: 指情节或情感发展的'最高潮点',可出现在中段或结尾,强调张力顶峰;finale 特指'最后的收场段落',强调'结束'这一位置

synonyms.example: The essay's conclusion tied every strand of the argument together with quiet, undeniable force. （议论文·文章收束）
synonyms.usage: 中性、通用,指任何事物的'结尾'或'结论';finale 更华丽、更戏剧化,专用于表演、音乐或盛大场合的'压轴收场'

synonyms.example: In the novel's quiet denouement, every mystery was gently laid to rest and each character found an unexpected peace. （议论文·文学分析）
synonyms.usage: 书面文学术语,指故事情节'解开悬念、走向结局'的部分;finale 侧重'终场演出/终乐章',用于表演艺术,不专指叙事结局

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·「压轴/终场」高分表达
advancedExpressions.expression: a grand finale · the season/series finale · a fitting finale to sth · reach a triumphant finale · bring sth to a finale
advancedExpressions.example: 课堂速记：a grand finale（盛大压轴）→ a fitting finale to a career（生涯完美收尾）→ the series finale（剧集大结局）→ bring the show to a dramatic finale（使演出迎来戏剧性落幕）。一组词覆盖音乐、演出、剧集、人生四类场景。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「结尾/收场」按语体分层
advancedExpressions.expression: ending（最普通）< conclusion（正式收束）< finale（华丽压轴，多用于表演/音乐/盛会）< climax（情感/情节最高潮，未必在最后）
advancedExpressions.example: 写作择词：叙事结局用 ending/conclusion；音乐会、颁奖礼、烟花秀的压轴用 finale；情节张力顶点用 climax。The concert ended（普通）→ The concert built to a grand finale（升级）。

advancedExpressions.expression: final(adj.最后的 / n.决赛) → finale(n.终乐章，源自意大利语音乐术语，读 /fɪˈnɑːli/) → finalise/finalize(v.敲定) → finalist(n.决赛选手) → finality(n.终结性)
advancedExpressions.example: 辨音辨义：final 读 /ˈfaɪnl/，finale 读 /fɪˈnɑːli/，注意 e 要发音、重音在第二音节。final 强调'最后一个'，finale 强调'那段华丽的收场'。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·finale 作抽象名词的冠词与介词搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: the finale of sth（用 the + of）；a grand/fitting finale to sth（用 a + to）；a finale so + adj. + that ...（结果状语从句）
advancedExpressions.example: The finale of the opera（歌剧的终场，特指用 the...of）；a fitting finale to the tour（巡演的完美收官，用 to 表'为……的收尾'）；a finale so moving that the audience wept（如此动人的终场，以致观众落泪）。

advancedExpressions.expression: as ... thundered / soared into its finale, ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the orchestra soared into its finale, something inside her broke free at last, and years of buried grief poured out in a flood of unashamed tears. （as 引导背景高潮 + break free / pour out 情感爆发,续写结尾段升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: we invite you to witness the grand finale of ...
advancedExpressions.example: We warmly invite you to witness the grand finale of our charity week, an evening whose every song and speech will remind us why we began this journey together. （invite you to witness 郑重邀约 + 定语从句阐明意义,邀请信收尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as a symphony is judged by its finale, so ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a symphony is judged not by its opening but by the power of its finale, so a life is measured less by how brilliantly it begins than by how meaningfully it ends. （just as...so... 类比结构 + not...but 双重对照,议论文升华段）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The music ended and everyone clapped.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The final chord of the finale hung trembling in the air for a heartbeat of absolute silence — and then the hall exploded, hundreds rising to their feet in a thunder of applause that refused to die away. （读后续写·终场爆发）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: hang trembling 拟人化延长瞬间 + a heartbeat of...silence 时间意象放缓节奏 + 破折号制造停顿-爆发对比 + 现在分词状语(rising...)+ refused to die away 拟人收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: The story had a good ending.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The tale drew to a finale so quietly moving that readers closed the book not with the thrill of surprise, but with the ache of parting from friends they had come to love. （议论文·文学评述）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: draw to a finale 正式表达 + so...that 结果强调 + not with...but with... 对照结构 + the ache of parting 抽象情感名词化,拔高评述格调

classPractice.question: 《第九交响曲》也是贝多芬人生的盛大终章。Symphony No. 9 was also ____ ____ ____ to his life.
classPractice.note: 还原本单元贝多芬原句核心短语 a grand finale to sth，注意 finale 前用不定冠词 a、后接 to sth 表'为……的收场'。

classPractice.question: The concert built slowly at first, but the (final) ____ left the whole hall on their feet, cheering wildly.
classPractice.note: 此处需名词'终场'，用 finale（读 /fɪˈnɑːli/），与 final（决赛/最后的）区分；the ... finale 特指音乐会的那段压轴。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（finale / climax / conclusion）：The rescue reached its ____ when the last child was pulled alive from the flames — the most heart-stopping moment of the whole night.
classPractice.note: '最紧张的最高潮点、未必在结尾'用 climax；finale 特指最后的华丽收场，conclusion 指中性的结尾/结论。语境'最令人揪心的时刻'定 climax。

classPractice.question: 这场慈善晚会以一段感人至深的终场落下帷幕，观众久久不愿离去。（用 finale）
classPractice.answer: The charity evening came to / drew to a moving finale, and the audience were reluctant to leave for a long time. / The charity evening ended with a deeply moving finale, and ...
classPractice.note: 考 come/draw to a finale 或 end with a finale；finale 前用 a + 形容词，收尾场景高分词。

translation: 节奏，韵律，律动；规律
original_sentence: Do you detect a rhythm?
readingExamples: Do you detect a rhythm?
definitionEn:
(1) n. a regular, repeated pattern of sounds or beats in music, produced by strong and weak elements
(2) n. a regular pattern of movement, activity, or change; the recurring flow of something
(3) n. the arrangement of stressed and unstressed syllables that gives poetry or speech its beat and flow
(4) n. a naturally recurring cycle or pattern in nature or in the body, such as the seasons or a heartbeat

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （生活、工作等的）规律，节律，运转的常态
uncommonMeanings.example: It took months for the young widow to find a new rhythm to her days, learning slowly that an empty house could, in time, be filled again with small, purposeful routines. （读后续写·重建生活·生活节律）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （自然界的）周而复始的规律，韵律（如季节、潮汐、昼夜）
uncommonMeanings.example: The farmer lived by the ancient rhythm of the land — sowing when the swallows returned, reaping when the first frost silvered the fields. （读后续写·田园生活·自然节律）

posExamples.sentence: Do you detect a rhythm in the way the waves keep breaking on the shore, drawing back, and breaking again — as steady and unhurried as the breathing of some vast, sleeping creature? （读后续写·海边冥想·自然意象）
I am writing to recommend a daily study rhythm to our fellow candidates: an hour of focused reading at dawn, when the mind is clearest and the world is still. （应用文·经验分享／建议信）

A healthy society, much like a piece of music, depends on rhythm — on the balance between periods of intense effort and moments of genuine rest, without which even the strongest will eventually falter. （议论文·工作与休息·平衡论证）

The drummer began softly, and as the rhythm quickened, the whole square seemed to come alive, feet tapping, shoulders swaying, strangers grinning at one another as though they had always been friends. （读后续写·街头音乐·集体欢乐）

wordForms.noun: rhythm
wordForms.other: 拼写警示（本单元易错重点）：rhythm 全词无常规元音字母 a/e/i/o/u，字母 y 在此充当元音；结构记忆 r-h-y-th-m，注意两处 h（rhy- 与 -thm），词尾是 -thm（无元音，读 /ðəm/）。口诀：'Rhythm Helps Your Two Hips Move'（每个首字母拼出 rhythm）。派生词 rhythmic 同样保留这两个 h。

idioms.translation: 进入某事的节奏，渐入佳境
idioms.example: The first week at the new school was bewildering, but once she got into the rhythm of lessons, clubs and friendships, the days began to fly by. （读后续写·适应新环境）
A single careless mistake made the pianist lose his rhythm, and for a terrifying moment his fingers hovered, lost, above the keys. （读后续写·舞台失误·紧张时刻）

collocations.example: The song has a strong rhythm that makes you want to dance. 这首歌节奏强劲，让人忍不住想跳舞。

collocations.phrase: the rhythm of the music / of sth
collocations.example: They clapped in time to the rhythm of the music. 他们随着音乐的节奏拍手。
Modern pop owes much to rhythm and blues. 现代流行乐深受节奏布鲁斯的影响。
Even the little kids could feel the rhythm and started to sway. 连小孩子都能感受到节奏，跟着摇摆起来。
The song had a strong beat and a steady rhythm that made it almost impossible to sit still. （读后续写·音乐感染力）
The rowers kept a perfect rhythm, their oars slicing the water as one, so that the boat seemed to glide of its own accord. （读后续写·团队协作）
Even the toddlers swayed to the rhythm of the music, their tiny hands clapping half a beat behind everyone else. （读后续写·温馨场景）
She closed her eyes and let her body move to the rhythm, forgetting, for one liberating hour, every worry that had weighed upon her. （读后续写·情绪释放）
He had never learned to read music, yet his natural sense of rhythm let him keep pace with players twice his age. （读后续写·天赋异禀）

collocations.phrase: the rhythm of life / everyday life
collocations.example: Away from the city's frantic pace, they gradually settled into the gentle rhythm of village life, where the ringing of a distant bell marked the passing hours. （读后续写·归园田居）

collocations.translation: 进入某种节奏，形成规律
collocations.example: After a few chaotic days, the volunteers finally fell into a rhythm, and the once-overwhelming task began to feel manageable at last. （应用文·志愿感悟）
The sudden interruption broke the rhythm of the ceremony, and it took the host several awkward moments to recover the crowd's attention. （议论文／读后续写·突发状况）
Living close to the land, the old couple measured their years not by calendars but by the unchanging rhythm of the seasons. （读后续写·自然生活）

synonyms.example: The moment the beat dropped, the entire crowd surged forward as one pulsing mass of light and sound. （读后续写·演唱会现场）
synonyms.usage: 指音乐中'单个的、可数的节拍或重音',具体而基础;rhythm 指由这些节拍组合而成的'整体节奏模式',更抽象、更宏观

synonyms.translation: （音乐或活动的）速度，节拍快慢
synonyms.example: The conductor lifted his baton, and the tempo quickened until the strings raced like a heart in panic. （读后续写·音乐张力）
synonyms.usage: 特指'快慢速度'这一维度(快板／慢板);rhythm 指'强弱、长短的排列模式',二者常并提,但 tempo 只管速度,rhythm 管整体律动

synonyms.translation: （声音、语言的）抑扬顿挫，节奏感
synonyms.example: There was a soothing cadence to her voice, rising and falling like a lullaby half-remembered from childhood. （读后续写·声音描写）
synonyms.usage: 偏文学书面,多指'说话或诗句声音的高低起伏与收束';rhythm 更通用,可用于音乐、生活、自然等各种规律性律动

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·rhythm 词族 + 拼写警示
advancedExpressions.expression: rhythm(n.节奏) → rhythmic / rhythmical(adj.有节奏的) → rhythmically(adv.有节奏地)。拼写：r-h-y-t-h-m，全词无 a/e/i/o/u，y 作元音，两个 h、词尾 -thm。
advancedExpressions.example: 考场易错：漏掉第一个 h（误 rythm）或写错 y。口诀 'Rhythm Helps Your Two Hips Move' 逐字母拼出 rhythm。形容词 The music was highly rhythmic（富有节奏感的）。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·「节奏/律动」高分表达
advancedExpressions.expression: a strong / steady rhythm · move/dance/sway to the rhythm · keep (in) rhythm · fall into a rhythm · the rhythm of life/the seasons · a sense of rhythm
advancedExpressions.example: 课堂速记：a strong rhythm（强劲节奏）→ sway to the rhythm（随节奏摇摆）→ fall into a rhythm（进入规律）→ the rhythm of the seasons（四季更替的规律）。从'音乐节奏'延伸到'生活/自然的规律'是本词高阶考点。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·按侧重区分
advancedExpressions.expression: beat（单个可数节拍/鼓点）— tempo（快慢速度）— rhythm（强弱长短的整体律动模式）— cadence（书面：声音/语言的抑扬顿挫）
advancedExpressions.example: 写作择词：a fast tempo（速度快）≠ a strong rhythm（律动强）；the beat dropped（鼓点落下，具体一拍）vs the rhythm carried the whole song（节奏贯穿整曲）。三者常并提：strong rhythm, fast tempo, heavy beat。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·rhythm 的可数性与介词搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: rhythm 多作可数名词：a strong rhythm；泛指节奏感/协调时可不可数：have (a) sense of rhythm。介词固定：to the rhythm（随节奏），in rhythm with（与……合拍），the rhythm of sth。
advancedExpressions.example: dance to the rhythm（随节奏起舞，用 to）；Her steps fell in rhythm with the drums（她的脚步与鼓声合拍，用 in ... with）；the rhythm of everyday life（日常生活的节奏，用 of）。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·自然/心境交融
advancedExpressions.expression: sb.'s heart / breathing fell into rhythm with ...
advancedExpressions.example: Little by little, her ragged breathing fell into rhythm with the gentle lapping of the waves, and the panic that had gripped her chest at last loosened its hold. （fall into rhythm with 情景交融 + at last loosen its hold 拟人化释放情绪,续写心理转折）

advancedExpressions.expression: by establishing a steady rhythm of ..., one can ...
advancedExpressions.example: By establishing a steady rhythm of study, exercise and rest, one can weather even the most demanding examination season without burning out. （by doing 引导方法 + 三名词并列 + without burning out 点明收益,建议信主体）

advancedExpressions.expression: life, like music, thrives on rhythm — on the interplay of ... and ...
advancedExpressions.example: Life, like music, thrives on rhythm — on the delicate interplay of exertion and repose, ambition and contentment; strip away either, and the melody collapses into noise. （类比明喻 + on the interplay of...and... 揭示辩证关系 + 假设句收束警示）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The music had a nice rhythm and people danced.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: There was something irresistible in the rhythm — a heartbeat pulsing beneath the melody — and before long even the shyest among us were on our feet, swept up in a joy that words could never have summoned. （读后续写·音乐感染）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: There be 强调存在 + 破折号插入比喻(a heartbeat pulsing...) + before long 时间推进 + even the shyest 极端例证 + a joy that...从句升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: We need to balance work and rest in life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Just as no symphony can survive on a single relentless note, so no life can flourish without the rhythm of striving and stillness, of pushing forward and pausing to breathe. （议论文·平衡论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Just as...so... 类比结构 + 音乐隐喻贯穿 + the rhythm of A and B 名词化对照 + of...and... 排比叠加,增强论证的哲理感与文采

classPractice.question: The dancers moved gracefully in time to the ____ (rhythm) of the drums, their steps rising and falling as one.
classPractice.note: 拼写重点词！r-h-y-t-h-m 全词无常规元音，y 作元音，两个 h、词尾 -thm，别漏第一个 h。move to the rhythm 固定搭配。

classPractice.question: The whole piece was highly ____ (rhythm), the strong beat pulsing through the hall like a heartbeat.
classPractice.note: 考形容词形式 rhythmic/rhythmical（有节奏的），注意派生词同样保留两个 h；副词形式为 rhythmically。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（rhythm / tempo / beat）：As the drummer sped up, the ____ quickened until dancers could barely keep up — it now felt twice as fast as before.
classPractice.note: '速度加快'这一维度用 tempo（快慢）；rhythm 指整体强弱律动，beat 指单个节拍。语境'twice as fast'锁定 tempo。

classPractice.question: 远离城市的喧嚣，他们渐渐适应了乡村生活的慢节奏。（用 the rhythm of）
classPractice.answer: Away from the noise of the city, they gradually settled into / got used to the slow rhythm of country / village life.
classPractice.note: 考 the rhythm of + 生活（由'音乐节奏'引申为'生活的规律/节奏'），注意 rhythm 拼写；settle into / get used to 搭配'适应'。
